q1: SELECT i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, avg( cast(cs_quantity as decimal(12,2))) agg1, avg( cast(cs_list_price as decimal(12,2))) agg2, avg( cast(cs_coupon_amt as decimal(12,2))) agg3, avg( cast(cs_sales_price as decimal(12,2))) agg4, avg( cast(cs_net_profit as decimal(12,2))) agg5, avg( cast(c_birth_year as decimal(12,2))) agg6 from catalog_sales, customer_demographics, customer, customer_address, date_dim, item where cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and cs_item_sk = i_item_sk and cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and cd_gender = 'M' and cd_education_status = 'College' and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and d_year = 1999 and c_birth_month = 7 and ca_state in ('CO', 'TX', 'MD') and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND i_category = 'Electronics' group by rollup (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county) order by ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
), filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Electronics'
), filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk, c_birth_year
    FROM customer
    WHERE c_birth_month = 7
), filtered_demo AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'M'
      AND cd_education_status = 'College'
), filtered_addr AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('CO', 'TX', 'MD')
), filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_bill_cdemo_sk, cs_quantity, cs_list_price, cs_coupon_amt, cs_sales_price, cs_net_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
      AND cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    a.ca_country,
    a.ca_state,
    a.ca_county,
    avg(cs.cs_quantity::decimal(12,2)) AS agg1,
    avg(cs.cs_list_price::decimal(12,2)) AS agg2,
    avg(cs.cs_coupon_amt::decimal(12,2)) AS agg3,
    avg(cs.cs_sales_price::decimal(12,2)) AS agg4,
    avg(cs.cs_net_profit::decimal(12,2)) AS agg5,
    avg(c.c_birth_year::decimal(12,2)) AS agg6
FROM filtered_sales cs
JOIN filtered_items i
  ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN filtered_customers c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
JOIN filtered_demo cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
JOIN filtered_addr a
  ON a.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, a.ca_country, a.ca_state, a.ca_county)
ORDER BY a.ca_country, a.ca_state, a.ca_county, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count, count(*) as cnt from store_sales, web_sales, date_dim d1, date_dim d2, customer, inventory, store, warehouse, item, customer_demographics, household_demographics, customer_address where ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30 day') and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity and s_state = w_state AND i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Music', 'Men') and i_manager_id IN (72, 26, 92, 76, 36, 1, 98, 21, 90, 55) and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_state in ('OH', 'MI', 'WI', 'OR', 'CA') and d1.d_year = 1998 and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count order by cnt ;
q2:
WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Music', 'Men')
      AND i_manager_id IN (72, 26, 92, 76, 36, 1, 98, 21, 90, 55)
), filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
), filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_current_cdemo_sk,
           c.c_current_hdemo_sk
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('OH', 'MI', 'WI', 'OR', 'CA')
), filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
           ss.ss_customer_sk,
           ss.ss_sold_date_sk,
           ss.ss_quantity
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_items fi
      ON fi.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_dates d1
      ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
), eligible_web_sales AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk,
           ws.ws_bill_customer_sk,
           ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
           ws.ws_warehouse_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
), matched_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk,
           ss.ss_item_sk,
           ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    FROM filtered_store_sales ss
    JOIN eligible_web_sales ws
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
     AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_dates d1
      ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
     AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '30 day')
    JOIN warehouse w
      ON w.w_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
    JOIN inventory inv
      ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
     AND inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
     AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
     AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store s
        WHERE s.s_state = w.w_state
    )
)
SELECT cd.cd_gender,
       cd.cd_marital_status,
       cd.cd_education_status,
       hd.hd_vehicle_count,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM matched_sales ms
JOIN filtered_customers c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = ms.ss_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON hd.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender,
         cd.cd_marital_status,
         cd.cd_education_status,
         hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

q2: WITH filtered_returns AS ( SELECT cr_order_number, cr_item_sk, cr_refunded_cash FROM catalog_returns WHERE cr_reason_sk = 49 ), filtered_sales AS ( SELECT cs_order_number, cs_item_sk, cs_warehouse_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_sales_price FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 64 ), filtered_items AS ( SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Books' AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 62 ), filtered_dates AS ( SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-03-07' - INTERVAL '30 day' AND DATE '2000-03-07' + INTERVAL '30 day' ) SELECT w.w_state, i.i_item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_date < DATE '2000-03-07' THEN fs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(fr.cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before, SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_date >= DATE '2000-03-07' THEN fs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(fr.cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after FROM filtered_returns fr JOIN filtered_sales fs ON fs.cs_order_number = fr.cr_order_number AND fs.cs_item_sk = fr.cr_item_sk JOIN filtered_items i ON i.i_item_sk = fs.cs_item_sk JOIN filtered_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = fs.cs_sold_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = fs.cs_warehouse_sk GROUP BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id ORDER BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id LIMIT 100;

q2: WITH filtered_date AS (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001), filtered_item AS (SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Women'), filtered_store AS (SELECT s_store_sk, s_state FROM store WHERE s_state = 'AZ'), filtered_demo AS (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'College') SELECT fi.i_item_id, fs.s_state, GROUPING(fs.s_state) AS g_state, AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1, AVG(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2, AVG(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4 FROM store_sales ss JOIN filtered_date fd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk JOIN filtered_item fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk JOIN filtered_store fs ON ss.ss_store_sk = fs.s_store_sk JOIN filtered_demo fcd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = fcd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY ROLLUP (fi.i_item_id, fs.s_state) ORDER BY fi.i_item_id, fs.s_state LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name, count(*) as cnt FROM store_sales, store_returns, web_sales, date_dim d1, date_dim d2, item, customer, customer_address, household_demographics WHERE ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND sr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Women', 'Men', 'Shoes') AND sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date between d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '90 day') AND ca_state in ('CO', 'GA', 'MD', 'WA', 'MD') AND d1.d_year = 1999 AND hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 1 AND 62 AND hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 1 * 0.01 AND 78 * 0.01 GROUP BY c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name ORDER BY cnt ;
q2:
WITH d1_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
), sr_filtered AS (
    SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_returned_date_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN d1_filtered d1
      ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
), item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Women', 'Men', 'Shoes')
), customer_filtered AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd
      ON hd.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
    WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('CO', 'GA', 'MD', 'WA')
      AND hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 1 AND 62
      AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
), ss_filtered AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN sr_filtered sr
      ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
     AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    JOIN item_filtered i
      ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_sales_price / NULLIF(ss.ss_list_price, 0) BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.78
), ws_exists AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_customer_sk
    FROM ss_filtered ss
    JOIN sr_filtered sr
      ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
     AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN date_dim d2
          ON d2.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
        JOIN d1_filtered d1
          ON d1.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
        WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
          AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
          AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND d1.d_date + interval '90 day'
    )
)
SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_last_name,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM ws_exists x
JOIN customer_filtered c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = x.ss_customer_sk
GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
ORDER BY cnt;

WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 17 AND 27
),
cs_ui AS (
    SELECT cs.cs_item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
      ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
     AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    JOIN filtered_items fi
      ON fi.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash + cr.cr_reversed_charge + cr.cr_store_credit)
),
filtered_promotions AS (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'Y'
      AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
      AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
),
filtered_cd AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('S','D')
      AND cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree','Primary','4 yr Degree')
),
filtered_current_addr AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_city, ca_zip
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('VA','OR','MA')
),
cross_sales AS (
    SELECT
        fi.i_product_name AS product_name,
        fi.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        s.s_zip AS store_zip,
        ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
        ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
        ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
        ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
        ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
        ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
        ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
        ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
        d1.d_year AS syear,
        d2.d_year AS fsyear,
        d3.d_year AS s2year,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        SUM(ss.ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
        SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS s2,
        SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
    FROM filtered_items fi
    JOIN cs_ui
      ON cs_ui.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
     AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    JOIN store_returns sr
      ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
     AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN filtered_promotions p
      ON p.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
    JOIN store s
      ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1
      ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
     AND d1.d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    JOIN customer c
      ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN filtered_cd cd1
      ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd1
      ON hd1.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad1
      ON ad1.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
    JOIN filtered_cd cd2
      ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
     AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
    JOIN household_demographics hd2
      ON hd2.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
    JOIN filtered_current_addr ad2
      ON ad2.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_date_sk = c.c_first_sales_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d3
      ON d3.d_date_sk = c.c_first_shipto_date_sk
    GROUP BY
        fi.i_product_name,
        fi.i_item_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_zip,
        ad1.ca_street_number,
        ad1.ca_street_name,
        ad1.ca_city,
        ad1.ca_zip,
        ad2.ca_street_number,
        ad2.ca_street_name,
        ad2.ca_city,
        ad2.ca_zip,
        d1.d_year,
        d2.d_year,
        d3.d_year
)
SELECT

    cs1.store_name,
    cs1.store_zip,
    cs1.b_street_number,
    cs1.b_street_name,
    cs1.b_city,
    cs1.b_zip,
    cs1.c_street_number,
    cs1.c_street_name,
    cs1.c_city,
    cs1.c_zip,
    cs1.syear,
    cs1.cnt,
    cs1.s1 AS s11,

    cs1.s3 AS s31,
    cs2.s1 AS s12,
    cs2.s2 AS s22,
    cs2.s3 AS s32,
    cs2.syear,
    cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales cs1
JOIN cross_sales cs2
  ON cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk
 AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name
 AND cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip
 AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt

WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Electronics'
      AND i_class = 'VALUE_1'
), base_month AS (
    SELECT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
      AND d_moy = 9
    LIMIT 1
), eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_current_addr_sk
    FROM customer c
    WHERE c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1948 AND 2048
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_sales cs
          JOIN filtered_items i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
          JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
          WHERE cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
            AND d.d_moy = 9
            AND d.d_year = 2000
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_sales ws
          JOIN filtered_items i ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
          JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
          WHERE ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
            AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
            AND d.d_moy = 9
            AND d.d_year = 2000
      )
), filtered_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_county, s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('CO','GA','NJ','FL','NC','WA','PA','MA','CA')
), my_revenue AS (
    SELECT ec.c_customer_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM eligible_customers ec
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = ec.c_current_addr_sk
    JOIN filtered_stores s
      ON s.s_county = ca.ca_county
     AND s.s_state = ca.ca_state
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_customer_sk = ec.c_customer_sk
     AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    CROSS JOIN base_month bm
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN bm.d_month_seq + 1 AND bm.d_month_seq + 3
    GROUP BY ec.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT CAST(revenue / 50 AS int) AS segment,
       COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
       CAST(revenue / 50 AS int) * 50 AS segment_base
FROM my_revenue
GROUP BY CAST(revenue / 50 AS int)
ORDER BY segment, num_customers
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1208 AND 1219
),
store_set AS (
    SELECT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM store_sales s
    JOIN filtered_dates d
      ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
      ON c.c_customer_sk = s.ss_customer_sk
     AND c.c_birth_month IN (3, 9, 2, 82)
    WHERE s.ss_list_price BETWEEN 103 AND 203
      AND s.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
),
catalog_set AS (
    SELECT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN filtered_dates d
      ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
      ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
     AND c.c_birth_month IN (3, 9, 2, 65)
    WHERE cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 103 AND 203
      AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
),
web_set AS (
    SELECT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN filtered_dates d
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
      ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
     AND c.c_birth_month IN (3, 9, 2, 78)
    WHERE ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 103 AND 203
      AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, d.d_date
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM store_set s
JOIN catalog_set c
  ON s.c_last_name = c.c_last_name
 AND s.c_first_name = c.c_first_name
 AND s.d_date = c.d_date
JOIN web_set w
  ON s.c_last_name = w.c_last_name
 AND s.c_first_name = w.c_first_name
 AND s.d_date = w.d_date
LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT
        cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ca.ca_state AS ctr_state,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON d.d_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk
     AND d.d_year = 2000
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = cr.cr_returning_addr_sk
    GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, ca.ca_state
), state_avg_return AS (
    SELECT
        ctr_state,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_total_return_threshold
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    ca.ca_street_number,
    ca.ca_street_name,
    ca.ca_street_type,
    ca.ca_suite_number,
    ca.ca_city,
    ca.ca_county,
    ca.ca_state,
    ca.ca_zip,
    ca.ca_country,
    ca.ca_gmt_offset,
    ca.ca_location_type,
    ctr.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr
JOIN state_avg_return sar
  ON sar.ctr_state = ctr.ctr_state
 AND ctr.ctr_total_return > sar.avg_total_return_threshold
JOIN customer c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr.ctr_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
 AND ca.ca_state = 'AZ'
ORDER BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    ca.ca_street_number,
    ca.ca_street_name,
    ca.ca_street_type,
    ca.ca_suite_number,
    ca.ca_city,
    ca.ca_county,
    ca.ca_state,
    ca.ca_zip,
    ca.ca_country,
    ca.ca_gmt_offset,
    ca.ca_location_type,
    ctr.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-04-19' AND DATE '1998-04-19' + INTERVAL '30 day'
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price > 50
      AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Shoes')
),
filtered_promotions AS (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'Y'
      AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
      AND p_channel_radio = 'N'
      AND p_channel_press = 'Y'
      AND p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
store_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT sr_item_sk, sr_ticket_number,
           SUM(sr_return_amt) AS return_amt,
           SUM(sr_net_loss) AS net_loss
    FROM store_returns
    GROUP BY sr_item_sk, sr_ticket_number
),
catalog_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT cr_item_sk, cr_order_number,
           SUM(cr_return_amount) AS return_amt,
           SUM(cr_net_loss) AS net_loss
    FROM catalog_returns
    GROUP BY cr_item_sk, cr_order_number
),
web_returns_agg AS (
    SELECT wr_item_sk, wr_order_number,
           SUM(wr_return_amt) AS return_amt,
           SUM(wr_net_loss) AS net_loss
    FROM web_returns
    GROUP BY wr_item_sk, wr_order_number
),
ssr AS (
    SELECT s.s_store_id AS store_id,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(COALESCE(sr.return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
           SUM(ss.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM filtered_items i
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
     AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    JOIN filtered_promotions p
      ON p.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
    JOIN filtered_dates d
      ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN store s
      ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns_agg sr
      ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
     AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id
),
csr AS (
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(COALESCE(cr.return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
           SUM(cs.cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr.net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM filtered_items i
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
      ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
     AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    JOIN filtered_promotions p
      ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
    JOIN filtered_dates d
      ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_page cp
      ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns_agg cr
      ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
     AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
    SELECT wsit.web_site_id AS web_site_id,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(COALESCE(wr.return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr.net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM filtered_items i
    JOIN web_sales ws
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
     AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    JOIN filtered_promotions p
      ON p.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
    JOIN filtered_dates d
      ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    JOIN web_site wsit
      ON wsit.web_site_sk = ws.ws_web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns_agg wr
      ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
     AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    GROUP BY wsit.web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || store_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           profit
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           profit
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           profit
    FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT count(distinct ws_order_number) as "order count" ,sum(ws_ext_ship_cost) as "total shipping cost" ,sum(ws_net_profit) as "total net profit" from web_sales ws1 ,date_dim ,customer_address ,web_site where d_date between '1998-10-01' and cast('1998-10-01' as date) + interval '60 day' and ws1.ws_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk and ws1.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_state in ('CO','MI','MD' ,'MI' ,'CA' ,'TX') and ws1.ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk and web_gmt_offset >= '-5' and ws1.ws_list_price between 1 and 81 and exists (select * from web_sales ws2 where ws1.ws_order_number = ws2.ws_order_number and ws1.ws_warehouse_sk <> ws2.ws_warehouse_sk) and not exists(select * from web_returns wr1 where ws1.ws_order_number = wr1.wr_order_number and wr1.wr_reason_sk in (9, 5, 43, 10, 66) ) order by count(distinct ws_order_number) LIMIT 100;
q2: WITH filtered_dates AS ( SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-10-01' AND DATE '1998-10-01' + INTERVAL '60 day' ), filtered_returns AS ( SELECT DISTINCT wr_order_number FROM web_returns WHERE wr_reason_sk IN (9, 5, 43, 10, 66) ), multi_warehouse_orders AS ( SELECT ws_order_number FROM web_sales WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 1 AND 81 GROUP BY ws_order_number HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ws_warehouse_sk) > 1 ), filtered_addresses AS ( SELECT ca_address_sk FROM customer_address WHERE ca_state IN ('CO','MI','MD','CA','TX') ), filtered_sites AS ( SELECT web_site_sk FROM web_site WHERE web_gmt_offset >= '-5' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS "order count", SUM(ws.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost", SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS "total net profit" FROM web_sales ws JOIN filtered_dates d ON ws.ws_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN filtered_addresses ca ON ws.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN filtered_sites s ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = s.web_site_sk JOIN multi_warehouse_orders mwo ON ws.ws_order_number = mwo.ws_order_number LEFT JOIN filtered_returns fr ON ws.ws_order_number = fr.wr_order_number WHERE ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 1 AND 81 AND fr.wr_order_number IS NULL LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
),
week_seq_this AS (
    SELECT d_week_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9
),
week_seq_last AS (
    SELECT d_week_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Men', 'Shoes')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 67
),
common_groups AS (
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_items fi ON fi.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
    INTERSECT
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN filtered_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_items fi ON fi.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
    INTERSECT
    SELECT fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN filtered_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_items fi ON fi.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
),
cross_items AS (
    SELECT fi.i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk, fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
    FROM filtered_items fi
    JOIN common_groups cg
      ON fi.i_brand_id = cg.i_brand_id
     AND fi.i_class_id = cg.i_class_id
     AND fi.i_category_id = cg.i_category_id
),
avg_sales AS (
    SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.ss_quantity AS quantity, ss.ss_list_price AS list_price
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN filtered_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cs.cs_quantity AS quantity, cs.cs_list_price AS list_price
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN filtered_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
        WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ws.ws_quantity AS quantity, ws.ws_list_price AS list_price
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN filtered_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
        WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    ) u
),
this_year AS (
    SELECT
        'store' AS channel,
        ci.i_brand_id,
        ci.i_class_id,
        ci.i_category_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
        COUNT(*) AS number_sales
    FROM week_seq_this w
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_week_seq = w.d_week_seq
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN cross_items ci ON ci.ss_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY ci.i_brand_id, ci.i_class_id, ci.i_category_id
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
),
last_year AS (
    SELECT
        'store' AS channel,
        ci.i_brand_id,
        ci.i_class_id,
        ci.i_category_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
        COUNT(*) AS number_sales
    FROM week_seq_last w
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_week_seq = w.d_week_seq
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN cross_items ci ON ci.ss_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY ci.i_brand_id, ci.i_class_id, ci.i_category_id
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
)
SELECT
    ty.channel AS ty_channel,
    ty.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
    ty.i_class_id AS ty_class,
    ty.i_category_id AS ty_category,
    ty.sales AS ty_sales,
    ty.number_sales AS ty_number_sales,
    ly.channel AS ly_channel,
    ly.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
    ly.i_class_id AS ly_class,
    ly.i_category_id AS ly_category,
    ly.sales AS ly_sales,
    ly.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM this_year ty
JOIN last_year ly
  ON ty.i_brand_id = ly.i_brand_id
 AND ty.i_class_id = ly.i_class_id
 AND ty.i_category_id = ly.i_category_id
ORDER BY ty.channel, ty.i_brand_id, ty.i_class_id, ty.i_category_id
LIMIT 100;

q2: WITH filtered_dates AS (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2002-08-08' AND DATE '2002-08-08' + INTERVAL '90 day'), filtered_items AS (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_manufact_id BETWEEN 908 AND 1008 OR i_category IN ('Jewelry','Music','Men')), avg_discount AS (SELECT ws_item_sk, 1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS threshold FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND ws_sales_price / NULLIF(ws_list_price,0) BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.62 AND ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates) GROUP BY ws_item_sk) SELECT SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount" FROM web_sales ws JOIN filtered_items i ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk JOIN filtered_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk JOIN avg_discount ad ON ad.ws_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > ad.threshold LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_returning_customer_sk,
           wr.wr_reason_sk,
           wr.wr_return_amt,
           ca.ca_state
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON d.d_date_sk = wr.wr_returned_date_sk
     AND d.d_year = 2001
    JOIN item i
      ON i.i_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
     AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 86
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_returning_addr_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_reason_sk IN (18, 55)
      AND wr.wr_return_quantity <> 0
      AND wr.wr_return_amt / wr.wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 187 AND 287
), customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           ca_state AS ctr_state,
           wr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
           SUM(wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM filtered_returns
    GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state, wr_reason_sk
), state_avg AS (
    SELECT ctr_state,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_total_return_threshold
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id,
       c.c_salutation,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_last_name,
       c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       c.c_birth_day,
       c.c_birth_month,
       c.c_birth_year,
       c.c_birth_country,
       c.c_login,
       c.c_email_address,
       c.c_last_review_date_sk,
       ctr.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr
JOIN state_avg sa
  ON sa.ctr_state = ctr.ctr_state
 AND ctr.ctr_total_return > sa.avg_total_return_threshold
JOIN customer c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr.ctr_customer_sk
 AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1949 AND 2049
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
 AND ca.ca_state IN ('MI', 'OH', 'CO')
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id,
         c.c_salutation,
         c.c_first_name,
         c.c_last_name,
         c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
         c.c_birth_day,
         c.c_birth_month,
         c.c_birth_year,
         c.c_birth_country,
         c.c_login,
         c.c_email_address,
         c.c_last_review_date_sk,
         ctr.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

q2:
WITH filtered_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_name
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('IN','IL','OH')
), filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_desc, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manager_id BETWEEN 22 AND 122
), sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_stores fs
      ON fs.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    JOIN filtered_items fi
      ON fi.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233
      AND ss.ss_sales_price / NULLIF(ss.ss_list_price, 0) BETWEEN 0.34 AND 1.34
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk
), store_avg AS (
    SELECT ss_store_sk, AVG(revenue) AS ave
    FROM sales_agg
    GROUP BY ss_store_sk
)
SELECT fs.s_store_name,
       fi.i_item_desc,
       sa.revenue,
       fi.i_current_price,
       fi.i_wholesale_cost,
       fi.i_brand
FROM sales_agg sa
JOIN store_avg avg_sa
  ON avg_sa.ss_store_sk = sa.ss_store_sk
JOIN filtered_stores fs
  ON fs.s_store_sk = sa.ss_store_sk
JOIN filtered_items fi
  ON fi.i_item_sk = sa.ss_item_sk
WHERE sa.revenue <= 0.1 * avg_sa.ave
ORDER BY fs.s_store_name, fi.i_item_desc
LIMIT 100;

WITH dd_2001 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
dd_2001_11 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
      AND d_moy = 11
),
frequent_ss_items AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN dd_2001 d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 136
      AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Men', 'Sports')
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, d.d_date, substring(i.i_item_desc, 1, 30)
    HAVING count(*) > 4
),
customer_sales_2001 AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_sales_price) AS csales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN dd_2001 d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk
),
max_store_sales AS (
    SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax
    FROM customer_sales_2001
),
best_ss_customer AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1949 AND 2049
    GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_sales_price) > 0.95 * (SELECT tpcds_cmax FROM max_store_sales)
)
SELECT SUM(sales)
FROM (
    SELECT cs.cs_quantity * cs.cs_list_price AS sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN dd_2001_11 d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN frequent_ss_items f ON f.item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN best_ss_customer b ON b.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ws.ws_quantity * ws.ws_list_price AS sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN dd_2001_11 d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN frequent_ss_items f ON f.item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    JOIN best_ss_customer b ON b.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
) tmp2
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 10
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Books', 'Home')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 9 AND 109
),
store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_items i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_sales_price / NULLIF(ss.ss_list_price, 0) BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.51
),
web_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN filtered_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_items i ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sales_price / NULLIF(ws.ws_list_price, 0) BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.51
),
catalog_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN filtered_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_items i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_sales_price / NULLIF(cs.cs_list_price, 0) BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.51
),
qualified_customers AS (
    SELECT sc.customer_sk
    FROM store_customers sc
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_customers wc
        WHERE wc.customer_sk = sc.customer_sk
    )
    UNION
    SELECT sc.customer_sk
    FROM store_customers sc
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_customers cc
        WHERE cc.customer_sk = sc.customer_sk
    )
)
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
    cd.cd_dep_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt4,
    cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
    cd.cd_dep_college_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt6
FROM qualified_customers qc
JOIN customer c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = qc.customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
WHERE ca.ca_county IN ('VALUE_1', 'VALUE_2', 'VALUE_3', 'VALUE_4', 'VALUE_5')
  AND c.c_birth_month = 11
  AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
  AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('M', 'S')
  AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', '2 yr Degree', 'Secondary')
GROUP BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    cd.cd_dep_count,
    cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
    cd.cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    cd.cd_dep_count,
    cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
    cd.cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;

q2:
WITH d1_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_week_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
),
cs_filtered AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk,
           cs_order_number,
           cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
           cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
           cs_sold_date_sk,
           cs_ship_date_sk,
           cs_quantity,
           cs_wholesale_cost,
           cs_promo_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
),
hd_filtered AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
),
cd_filtered AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd_dep_count BETWEEN 1 AND 54
),
item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_category
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Women', 'Jewelry', 'Shoes')
)
SELECT MIN(i.i_item_sk) AS min_i_item_sk,
       MIN(w.w_warehouse_name) AS min_w_warehouse_name,
       MIN(d1.d_week_seq) AS min_d_week_seq,
       MIN(cs.cs_item_sk) AS min_cs_item_sk,
       MIN(cs.cs_order_number) AS min_cs_order_number,
       MIN(inv.inv_item_sk) AS min_inv_item_sk
FROM d1_filtered d1
JOIN cs_filtered cs
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN hd_filtered hd
  ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
JOIN cd_filtered cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
JOIN item_filtered i
  ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN inventory inv
  ON inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
 AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < cs.cs_quantity
JOIN date_dim d2
  ON d2.d_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk
 AND d2.d_week_seq = d1.d_week_seq
JOIN date_dim d3
  ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_ship_date_sk
 AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day'
JOIN warehouse w
  ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p
  ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
  ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
 AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number;

q2: WITH filtered_dates AS (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 2), filtered_items AS (SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category = 'Women'), filtered_customers AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk FROM customer WHERE c_birth_month = 1), filtered_addresses AS (SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_zip FROM customer_address WHERE ca_state = 'CO') SELECT MIN(fi.i_brand_id), MIN(fi.i_manufact_id), MIN(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) FROM filtered_dates d JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 JOIN filtered_items fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN filtered_customers c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN filtered_addresses ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk WHERE substring(ca.ca_zip, 1, 5) <> substring(s.s_zip, 1, 5);

WITH cd_filtered AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree')
), ca_filtered AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca_state IN ('AZ','NY','OH','MI','FL','CO','WA')
), wr_filtered AS (
    SELECT wr.wr_item_sk,
           wr.wr_order_number,
           wr.wr_refunded_cash,
           wr.wr_fee,
           wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
           wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk,
           wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk,
           cd1.cd_demo_sk AS cd1_demo_sk,
           cd1.cd_marital_status,
           cd1.cd_education_status
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN cd_filtered cd1
      ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2
      ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
     AND cd2.cd_marital_status = cd1.cd_marital_status
     AND cd2.cd_education_status = cd1.cd_education_status
    JOIN ca_filtered ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
    JOIN reason r
      ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
), ws_filtered AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_quantity,
           ws.ws_item_sk,
           ws.ws_order_number,
           ws.ws_web_page_sk,
           ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
           ws.ws_sales_price,
           ws.ws_net_profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
     AND d.d_year = 2002
    WHERE ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
      AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
)
SELECT MIN(ws.ws_quantity) AS min_ws_quantity,
       MIN(wr.wr_refunded_cash) AS min_wr_refunded_cash,
       MIN(wr.wr_fee) AS min_wr_fee,
       MIN(ws.ws_item_sk) AS min_ws_item_sk,
       MIN(wr.wr_order_number) AS min_wr_order_number,
       MIN(wr.cd1_demo_sk) AS min_cd1_demo_sk,
       MIN(cd2.cd_demo_sk) AS min_cd2_demo_sk
FROM wr_filtered wr
JOIN ws_filtered ws
  ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
 AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN web_page wp
  ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd2

WHERE ((wr.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND wr.cd_education_status = 'Secondary' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
    OR (wr.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND wr.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)

q2:
WITH filtered_hd AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_dep_count
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_dep_count IN (1, 3)
), filtered_cd AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Unknown')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status IN ('Primary', 'Unknown'))
), filtered_ca AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca_state IN ('GA', 'AZ', 'WI', 'VA', 'CO', 'NJ', 'CA', 'FL')
), filtered_dd AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
), filtered_ss AS (
    SELECT ss_quantity, ss_ext_sales_price, ss_ext_wholesale_cost, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_addr_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_sales_price, ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
      AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
)
SELECT MIN(ss.ss_quantity) AS min_ss_quantity,
       MIN(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS min_ss_ext_sales_price,
       MIN(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost) AS min_ss_ext_wholesale_cost,
       MIN(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost) AS min_ss_ext_wholesale_cost_2
FROM filtered_ss ss
JOIN filtered_hd hd
  ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN filtered_dd dd
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_ca ca
  ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN filtered_cd cd
  ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN store s
  ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
WHERE (
        (cd.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Unknown' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 3)
     OR (cd.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1)
     OR (cd.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Unknown' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1)
      )
  AND (
        (ca.ca_state IN ('GA', 'AZ', 'WI') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
     OR (ca.ca_state IN ('VA', 'CO', 'NJ') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
     OR (ca.ca_state IN ('CA', 'FL', 'GA') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      );

q2:
SELECT MIN(i.i_item_id), MIN(s.s_state), MIN(ss.ss_quantity), MIN(ss.ss_list_price), MIN(ss.ss_coupon_amt), MIN(ss.ss_sales_price), MIN(ss.ss_item_sk), MIN(ss.ss_ticket_number)
FROM (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category = 'Music'
) i
JOIN store_sales ss
  ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1999
) d
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN (
  SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
  FROM store
  WHERE s_state = 'OR'
) s
  ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM customer_demographics cd
  WHERE cd.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
    AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'M'
    AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
);

		where

    FROM region
    WHERE r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'

    SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_acctbal, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone, s.s_comment, n.n_name
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
    JOIN target_region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey

	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_regionkey = r_regionkey

	and o_orderdate >= date '1994-01-01'

WITH europe_nations AS (
    SELECT n_nationkey, n_name
    FROM nation
    WHERE n_regionkey = (
        SELECT r_regionkey
        FROM region
        WHERE r_name = 'EUROPE'
    )
), filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey
    FROM orders
    WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
      AND o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01'
), customer_orders AS (
    SELECT fo.o_orderkey, c.c_nationkey
    FROM filtered_orders fo
    JOIN customer c
      ON c.c_custkey = fo.o_custkey
), matched_revenue AS (
    SELECT en.n_name,
           l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) AS revenue
    FROM customer_orders co
    JOIN lineitem l
      ON l.l_orderkey = co.o_orderkey
    JOIN supplier s
      ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
     AND s.s_nationkey = co.c_nationkey
    JOIN europe_nations en
      ON en.n_nationkey = co.c_nationkey
)
SELECT n_name,
       SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM matched_revenue
GROUP BY n_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

    FROM lineitem

LIMIT 100;

			from

WITH india_suppliers AS (
    SELECT s.s_suppkey
    FROM nation n
    JOIN supplier s
      ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    WHERE n.n_name = 'INDIA'
), india_partsupp AS (
    SELECT ps.ps_partkey,
           ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty AS value
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN india_suppliers i
      ON i.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
), threshold AS (
    SELECT SUM(value) * 0.0000100000 AS min_value
    FROM india_partsupp
)
SELECT ip.ps_partkey,
       SUM(ip.value) AS value
FROM india_partsupp ip
CROSS JOIN threshold t
GROUP BY ip.ps_partkey, t.min_value
HAVING SUM(ip.value) > t.min_value
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 1;

	)

    FROM part

           0.2 * AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_qty_threshold
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN filtered_part fp
      ON fp.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
    GROUP BY l.l_partkey
)

FROM filtered_part fp
JOIN part_avg_qty aq
  ON aq.l_partkey = fp.p_partkey

  ON l.l_partkey = fp.p_partkey
 AND l.l_quantity < aq.avg_qty_threshold

	and l_returnflag = 'R'
	and c_nationkey = n_nationkey
group by
	c_custkey,
	c_name,
	c_acctbal,
	c_phone,
	n_name,
	c_address,
	c_comment
order by
	revenue desc
limit 20;

    SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey
    FROM orders
    WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-11-01'
      AND o_orderdate < DATE '1993-11-01' + INTERVAL '3' month
), filtered_lineitem AS (
    SELECT l_orderkey, l_extendedprice, l_discount
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_returnflag = 'R'
)

    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,

    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,

    ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey

    c.c_comment

select
	o_year,
	sum(case
		when nation = 'CANADA' then volume
		else 0
	end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share
from
	(
		select
			extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,
			l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,
			n2.n_name as nation
		from
			part,
			supplier,
			lineitem,
			orders,
			customer,
			nation n1,
			nation n2,
			region
		where
			p_partkey = l_partkey
			and s_suppkey = l_suppkey
			and l_orderkey = o_orderkey
			and o_custkey = c_custkey
			and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
			and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey
			and r_name = 'AMERICA'
			and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
			and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'
			and p_type = 'SMALL BURNISHED STEEL'
	) as all_nations
group by
	o_year
order by
	o_year
limit 1;
q2:
WITH filtered_part AS (
    SELECT p_partkey
    FROM part
    WHERE p_type = 'SMALL BURNISHED STEEL'
), filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderdate
    FROM orders
    WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
      AND o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31'
), american_customers AS (
    SELECT c.c_custkey
    FROM customer c
    JOIN nation n1 ON n1.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
    JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n1.n_regionkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA'
), supplier_nation AS (
    SELECT s.s_suppkey, n2.n_name AS nation
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN nation n2 ON n2.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
)
SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS o_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sn.nation = 'CANADA' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END)
    / SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS mkt_share
FROM filtered_part p
JOIN lineitem l
  ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN filtered_orders o
  ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN american_customers ac
  ON ac.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN supplier_nation sn
  ON sn.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
ORDER BY o_year
LIMIT 1;

			and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
			and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
			and (
				(n1.n_name = 'KENYA' and n2.n_name = 'CANADA')
				or (n1.n_name = 'CANADA' and n2.n_name = 'KENYA')
			)
			and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'
	) as shipping

WITH n AS (
    SELECT n_nationkey, n_name
    FROM nation
    WHERE n_name IN ('KENYA', 'CANADA')
), s AS (
    SELECT s_suppkey, n.n_name AS supp_nation
    FROM supplier
    JOIN n ON supplier.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
), c AS (
    SELECT c_custkey, n.n_name AS cust_nation
    FROM customer
    JOIN n ON customer.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
), lo AS (
    SELECT l.l_suppkey,
           l.l_orderkey,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.l_shipdate) AS l_year,
           l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) AS volume
    FROM lineitem l
    WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31'
)
SELECT s.supp_nation,
       c.cust_nation,
       lo.l_year,
       SUM(lo.volume) AS revenue
FROM lo
JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = lo.l_orderkey
JOIN c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN s ON s.s_suppkey = lo.l_suppkey

   OR (s.supp_nation = 'CANADA' AND c.cust_nation = 'KENYA')
GROUP BY s.supp_nation, c.cust_nation, lo.l_year
ORDER BY s.supp_nation, c.cust_nation, lo.l_year
LIMIT 1;

      AND l_shipdate < DATE '1993-08-01'
    GROUP BY l_suppkey

    SELECT
        supplier_no,
        total_revenue,

    FROM revenue0
)

    s.s_address,

WHERE r.rnk = 1
ORDER BY s.s_suppkey
LIMIT 1;

from
	(
		select
			substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) as cntrycode,
			c_acctbal
		from

		where
			substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in
				('14', '29', '27', '23', '32', '10', '12')
			and c_acctbal > (
				select
					avg(c_acctbal)
				from
					customer
				where
					c_acctbal > 0.00
					and substring(c_phone from 1 for 2) in
						('14', '29', '27', '23', '32', '10', '12')
			)
			and not exists (
				select
					*
				from
					orders
				where
					o_custkey = c_custkey
			)
	) as custsale
group by
	cntrycode
order by
	cntrycode
limit 1;
q2:
WITH avg_bal AS (
    SELECT avg(c_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal
    FROM customer
    WHERE c_acctbal > 0.00
      AND substring(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 2) = ANY (ARRAY['14','29','27','23','32','10','12'])
), filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT substring(c.c_phone FROM 1 FOR 2) AS cntrycode,
           c.c_acctbal
    FROM customer c
    CROSS JOIN avg_bal a
    WHERE substring(c.c_phone FROM 1 FOR 2) = ANY (ARRAY['14','29','27','23','32','10','12'])
      AND c.c_acctbal > a.avg_acctbal
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM orders o
          WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
      )
)
SELECT cntrycode,
       count(*) AS numcust,
       sum(c_acctbal) AS totacctbal
FROM filtered_customers
GROUP BY cntrycode
ORDER BY cntrycode
LIMIT 1;

  AND cn.country_code = '[ru]'
  AND rt.role = 'actor'
  AND t.production_year > 2005
  AND t.id = mc.movie_id
  AND t.id = ci.movie_id
  AND ci.movie_id = mc.movie_id

WITH russian_companies AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM company_name
    WHERE country_code = '[ru]'
),
actor_role AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM role_type
    WHERE role = 'actor'
),
filtered_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.movie_id
    FROM movie_companies mc
    JOIN russian_companies cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
),
filtered_cast AS (
    SELECT ci.movie_id,
           ci.person_role_id
    FROM cast_info ci
    JOIN actor_role rt ON rt.id = ci.role_id
    WHERE ci.note LIKE '%(voice)%'
      AND ci.note LIKE '%(uncredited)%'
)

       MIN(t.title) AS russian_movie
FROM filtered_movies fm
JOIN title t ON t.id = fm.movie_id
           AND t.production_year > 2005
JOIN filtered_cast ci ON ci.movie_id = fm.movie_id
JOIN char_name chn ON chn.id = ci.person_role_id

);

       MIN(t1.title) AS first_movie,

FROM company_name AS cn1,

     title AS t1,

WHERE cn1.country_code = '[us]'
  AND it1.info = 'rating'
  AND it2.info = 'rating'
  AND kt1.kind IN ('tv series')
  AND kt2.kind IN ('tv series')
  AND lt.link IN ('sequel',
                  'follows',
                  'followed by')
  AND mi_idx2.info < '3.0'
  AND t2.production_year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2008
  AND lt.id = ml.link_type_id
  AND t1.id = ml.movie_id
  AND t2.id = ml.linked_movie_id
  AND it1.id = mi_idx1.info_type_id
  AND t1.id = mi_idx1.movie_id
  AND kt1.id = t1.kind_id
  AND cn1.id = mc1.company_id
  AND t1.id = mc1.movie_id
  AND ml.movie_id = mi_idx1.movie_id
  AND ml.movie_id = mc1.movie_id
  AND mi_idx1.movie_id = mc1.movie_id
  AND it2.id = mi_idx2.info_type_id
  AND t2.id = mi_idx2.movie_id
  AND kt2.id = t2.kind_id
  AND cn2.id = mc2.company_id
  AND t2.id = mc2.movie_id
  AND ml.linked_movie_id = mi_idx2.movie_id

WITH rating_info_type AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM info_type
    WHERE info = 'rating'
), tv_series_kind AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM kind_type
    WHERE kind = 'tv series'
), valid_link_types AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM link_type
    WHERE link IN ('sequel', 'follows', 'followed by')
), t2_filtered AS (
    SELECT t.id AS movie_id,
           t.title
    FROM title t
    JOIN tv_series_kind kt2 ON kt2.id = t.kind_id
    WHERE t.production_year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2008
), mi2_filtered AS (
    SELECT mi.movie_id,
           mi.info
    FROM movie_info_idx mi
    JOIN rating_info_type rit ON rit.id = mi.info_type_id
    WHERE mi.info < '3.0'
), t1_filtered AS (
    SELECT t.id AS movie_id,
           t.title
    FROM title t
    JOIN tv_series_kind kt1 ON kt1.id = t.kind_id
), mi1_filtered AS (
    SELECT mi.movie_id,
           mi.info
    FROM movie_info_idx mi
    JOIN rating_info_type rit ON rit.id = mi.info_type_id
), mc1_us AS (
    SELECT mc.movie_id,
           cn.name
    FROM movie_companies mc
    JOIN company_name cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    WHERE cn.country_code = '[us]'
), ml_filtered AS (
    SELECT ml.movie_id,
           ml.linked_movie_id
    FROM movie_link ml
    JOIN valid_link_types lt ON lt.id = ml.link_type_id
)
SELECT MIN(mc1.name) AS first_company,
       MIN(cn2.name) AS second_company,
       MIN(mi1.info) AS first_rating,
       MIN(mi2.info) AS second_rating,
       MIN(t1.title) AS first_movie,
       MIN(t2.title) AS second_movie
FROM ml_filtered ml
JOIN mi1_filtered mi1
  ON mi1.movie_id = ml.movie_id
JOIN t2_filtered t2
  ON t2.movie_id = ml.linked_movie_id
JOIN mi2_filtered mi2
  ON mi2.movie_id = ml.linked_movie_id
JOIN movie_companies mc2
  ON mc2.movie_id = ml.linked_movie_id
JOIN company_name cn2
  ON cn2.id = mc2.company_id
JOIN mc1_us mc1
  ON mc1.movie_id = ml.movie_id
JOIN t1_filtered t1
  ON t1.movie_id = ml.movie_id;

  AND ci.movie_id = t.id
  AND t.id = mc.movie_id
  AND ci.movie_id = mc.movie_id
  AND mc.company_id = cn.id
  AND ci.role_id = rt.id

    WHERE role = 'actress'

    SELECT ci.movie_id, ci.person_id, ci.person_role_id
    FROM cast_info ci
    JOIN actress_role ar ON ci.role_id = ar.id
    WHERE ci.note IN ('(voice)', '(voice: Japanese version)', '(voice) (uncredited)', '(voice: English version)')
), filtered_names AS (
    SELECT id, name
    FROM name
    WHERE gender = 'f'
      AND name LIKE '%An%'
), us_movies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.movie_id
    FROM movie_companies mc
    JOIN company_name cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    WHERE cn.country_code = '[us]'
)
SELECT MIN(an.name) AS alternative_name,
       MIN(chn.name) AS voiced_character_name,
       MIN(fn.name) AS voicing_actress,
       MIN(t.title) AS american_movie
FROM filtered_ci ci
JOIN filtered_names fn ON fn.id = ci.person_id
JOIN us_movies um ON um.movie_id = ci.movie_id
JOIN title t ON t.id = ci.movie_id
JOIN char_name chn ON chn.id = ci.person_role_id
LEFT JOIN aka_name an ON an.person_id = ci.person_id;

WITH customer_total_return 
     AS (SELECT sr_customer_sk     AS ctr_customer_sk, 
                sr_store_sk        AS ctr_store_sk, 
                Sum(sr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return 
         FROM   store_returns, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 2001 
         GROUP  BY sr_customer_sk, 
                   sr_store_sk) 
SELECT c_customer_id 
FROM   customer_total_return ctr1, 
       store, 
       customer 
WHERE  ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT Avg(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 
                                FROM   customer_total_return ctr2 
                                WHERE  ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk) 
       AND s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk 
       AND s_state = 'TN' 
       AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
ORDER  BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT sr_customer_sk,
           sr_store_sk,
           sr_return_amt
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN date_dim
      ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2001
), customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
           SUM(sr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM filtered_returns
    GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk
), store_avg_return AS (
    SELECT ctr_store_sk,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_total_return_threshold
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
), tn_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state = 'TN'
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr
JOIN store_avg_return sar
  ON sar.ctr_store_sk = ctr.ctr_store_sk
JOIN tn_stores ts
  ON ts.s_store_sk = ctr.ctr_store_sk
JOIN customer c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr.ctr_customer_sk
WHERE ctr.ctr_total_return > sar.avg_total_return_threshold
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT cd_gender, 
               cd_marital_status, 
               cd_education_status, 
               Count(*) cnt1, 
               cd_purchase_estimate, 
               Count(*) cnt2, 
               cd_credit_rating, 
               Count(*) cnt3, 
               cd_dep_count, 
               Count(*) cnt4, 
               cd_dep_employed_count, 
               Count(*) cnt5, 
               cd_dep_college_count, 
               Count(*) cnt6 
FROM   customer c, 
       customer_address ca, 
       customer_demographics 
WHERE  c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
       AND ca_county IN ( 'Lycoming County', 'Sheridan County', 
                          'Kandiyohi County', 
                          'Pike County', 
                                           'Greene County' ) 
       AND cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk 
       AND EXISTS (SELECT * 
                   FROM   store_sales, 
                          date_dim 
                   WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk 
                          AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                          AND d_year = 2002 
                          AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3) 
       AND ( EXISTS (SELECT * 
                     FROM   web_sales, 
                            date_dim 
                     WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk 
                            AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                            AND d_year = 2002 
                            AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3) 
              OR EXISTS (SELECT * 
                         FROM   catalog_sales, 
                                date_dim 
                         WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk 
                                AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                                AND d_year = 2002 
                                AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3) ) 
GROUP  BY cd_gender, 
          cd_marital_status, 
          cd_education_status, 
          cd_purchase_estimate, 
          cd_credit_rating, 
          cd_dep_count, 
          cd_dep_employed_count, 
          cd_dep_college_count 
ORDER  BY cd_gender, 
          cd_marital_status, 
          cd_education_status, 
          cd_purchase_estimate, 
          cd_credit_rating, 
          cd_dep_count, 
          cd_dep_employed_count, 
          cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 7
),
store_customers AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
web_customers AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
    GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk
),
catalog_customers AS (
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
    GROUP BY cs_ship_customer_sk
),
qualified_customers AS (
    SELECT sc.customer_sk
    FROM store_customers sc
    LEFT JOIN web_customers wc ON wc.customer_sk = sc.customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_customers cc ON cc.customer_sk = sc.customer_sk
    WHERE wc.customer_sk IS NOT NULL OR cc.customer_sk IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_addresses AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_county IN (
        'Lycoming County',
        'Sheridan County',
        'Kandiyohi County',
        'Pike County',
        'Greene County'
    )
)
SELECT cd.cd_gender,
       cd.cd_marital_status,
       cd.cd_education_status,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
       cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
       cd.cd_credit_rating,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
       cd.cd_dep_count,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt4,
       cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
       cd.cd_dep_college_count,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt6
FROM qualified_customers qc
JOIN customer c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = qc.customer_sk
JOIN filtered_addresses fa
  ON fa.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender,
         cd.cd_marital_status,
         cd.cd_education_status,
         cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
         cd.cd_credit_rating,
         cd.cd_dep_count,
         cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
         cd.cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY cd.cd_gender,
         cd.cd_marital_status,
         cd.cd_education_status,
         cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
         cd.cd_credit_rating,
         cd.cd_dep_count,
         cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
         cd.cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;

                   c_preferred_cust_flag,

         WHERE  c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk 
                AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
         GROUP  BY c_customer_id,

                   c_birth_country,

SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, 
               t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, 
               t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, 
               t_s_secyear.customer_birth_country 
FROM   year_total t_s_firstyear, 
       year_total t_s_secyear, 
       year_total t_w_firstyear, 
       year_total t_w_secyear 
WHERE  t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id 
       AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id 
       AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id 
       AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's' 
       AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w' 
       AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's' 
       AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w' 
       AND t_s_firstyear.dyear = 2001 
       AND t_s_secyear.dyear = 2001 + 1 
       AND t_w_firstyear.dyear = 2001 
       AND t_w_secyear.dyear = 2001 + 1 
       AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 
       AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 
       AND CASE 
             WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN t_w_secyear.year_total / 
                                                    t_w_firstyear.year_total 
             ELSE 0.0 
           END > CASE 
                   WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN 
                   t_s_secyear.year_total / 
                   t_s_firstyear.year_total 
                   ELSE 0.0 
                 END 
ORDER  BY t_s_secyear.customer_id, 
          t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, 
          t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, 
          t_s_secyear.customer_birth_country
LIMIT 100;

WITH store_year AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d.d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS store_year_total
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk, d.d_year
),
web_year AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        d.d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS web_year_total
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk, d.d_year
),
store_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        customer_sk,
        SUM(store_year_total) FILTER (WHERE dyear = 2001) AS store_2001,
        SUM(store_year_total) FILTER (WHERE dyear = 2002) AS store_2002
    FROM store_year
    GROUP BY customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(store_year_total) FILTER (WHERE dyear = 2001) > 0
       AND SUM(store_year_total) FILTER (WHERE dyear = 2002) IS NOT NULL
),
web_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        customer_sk,
        SUM(web_year_total) FILTER (WHERE dyear = 2001) AS web_2001,
        SUM(web_year_total) FILTER (WHERE dyear = 2002) AS web_2002
    FROM web_year
    GROUP BY customer_sk
    HAVING SUM(web_year_total) FILTER (WHERE dyear = 2001) > 0
       AND SUM(web_year_total) FILTER (WHERE dyear = 2002) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
    c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
    c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
    c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country
FROM store_pivot sp
JOIN web_pivot wp
  ON wp.customer_sk = sp.customer_sk
JOIN customer c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = sp.customer_sk
WHERE wp.web_2002 / wp.web_2001 > sp.store_2002 / sp.store_2001
ORDER BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_birth_country
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
         i_item_id , 
         i_item_desc , 
         i_category , 
         i_class , 
         i_current_price , 
         Sum(ws_ext_sales_price)                                                              AS itemrevenue ,
         Sum(ws_ext_sales_price)*100/Sum(Sum(ws_ext_sales_price)) OVER (partition BY i_class) AS revenueratio
FROM     web_sales , 
         item , 
         date_dim 
WHERE    ws_item_sk = i_item_sk 
AND      i_category IN ('Home', 
                        'Men', 
                        'Women') 
AND      ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
AND      d_date BETWEEN Cast('2000-05-11' AS DATE) AND      ( 
                  Cast('2000-05-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 day') 
GROUP BY i_item_id , 
         i_item_desc , 
         i_category , 
         i_class , 
         i_current_price 
ORDER BY i_category , 
         i_class , 
         i_item_id , 
         i_item_desc , 
         revenueratio 
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date >= DATE '2000-05-11'
      AND d_date < DATE '2000-05-11' + INTERVAL '31 day'
), filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_ext_sales_price
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_sold_date_sk IN (
        SELECT d_date_sk
        FROM filtered_dates
    )
), item_sales AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id,
           i.i_item_desc,
           i.i_category,
           i.i_class,
           i.i_current_price,
           SUM(fs.ws_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue
    FROM filtered_sales fs
    JOIN item i
      ON i.i_item_sk = fs.ws_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_category IN ('Home', 'Men', 'Women')
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id,
             i.i_item_desc,
             i.i_category,
             i.i_class,
             i.i_current_price
)
SELECT i_item_id,
       i_item_desc,
       i_category,
       i_class,
       i_current_price,
       itemrevenue,
       itemrevenue * 100.0 / SUM(itemrevenue) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class) AS revenueratio
FROM item_sales
ORDER BY i_category,
         i_class,
         i_item_id,
         i_item_desc,
         revenueratio
LIMIT 100;

SELECT Avg(ss_quantity), 
       Avg(ss_ext_sales_price), 
       Avg(ss_ext_wholesale_cost), 
       Sum(ss_ext_wholesale_cost) 
FROM   store_sales, 
       store, 
       customer_demographics, 
       household_demographics, 
       customer_address, 
       date_dim 
WHERE  s_store_sk = ss_store_sk 
       AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
       AND d_year = 2001 
       AND ( ( ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk 
               AND cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk 
               AND cd_marital_status = 'U' 
               AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' 
               AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 
               AND hd_dep_count = 3 ) 
              OR ( ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk 
                   AND cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk 
                   AND cd_marital_status = 'M' 
                   AND cd_education_status = 'Primary' 
                   AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 
                   AND hd_dep_count = 1 ) 
              OR ( ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk 
                   AND cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk 
                   AND cd_marital_status = 'D' 
                   AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary' 
                   AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00 
                   AND hd_dep_count = 1 ) ) 
       AND ( ( ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
               AND ca_country = 'United States' 
               AND ca_state IN ( 'AZ', 'NE', 'IA' ) 
               AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200 ) 
              OR ( ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                   AND ca_country = 'United States' 
                   AND ca_state IN ( 'MS', 'CA', 'NV' ) 
                   AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300 ) 
              OR ( ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                   AND ca_country = 'United States' 
                   AND ca_state IN ( 'GA', 'TX', 'NJ' ) 
                   AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250 ) );

WITH filtered_ss AS (
    SELECT ss_quantity,
           ss_ext_sales_price,
           ss_ext_wholesale_cost,
           ss_store_sk,
           ss_sold_date_sk,
           ss_hdemo_sk,
           ss_cdemo_sk,
           ss_addr_sk,
           ss_sales_price,
           ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
      AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
), filtered_hd AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk,
           hd_dep_count
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_dep_count IN (1, 3)
), filtered_cd AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk,
           cd_marital_status,
           cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary')
), filtered_ca AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk,
           ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca_state IN ('AZ', 'NE', 'IA', 'MS', 'CA', 'NV', 'GA', 'TX', 'NJ')
), filtered_dd AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
)
SELECT AVG(ss.ss_quantity),
       AVG(ss.ss_ext_sales_price),
       AVG(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost),
       SUM(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM filtered_ss ss
JOIN filtered_hd hd
  ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
JOIN filtered_dd dd
  ON dd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN filtered_ca ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
JOIN filtered_cd cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
JOIN store s
  ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
WHERE (
        (cd.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 3)
     OR (cd.cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1)
     OR (cd.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Secondary' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1)
      )
  AND (
        (ca.ca_state IN ('AZ', 'NE', 'IA') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
     OR (ca.ca_state IN ('MS', 'CA', 'NV') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
     OR (ca.ca_state IN ('GA', 'TX', 'NJ') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      );

SELECT ca_zip, 
               Sum(cs_sales_price) 
FROM   catalog_sales, 
       customer, 
       customer_address, 
       date_dim 
WHERE  cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
       AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
       AND ( Substr(ca_zip, 1, 5) IN ( '85669', '86197', '88274', '83405', 
                                       '86475', '85392', '85460', '80348', 
                                       '81792' ) 
              OR ca_state IN ( 'CA', 'WA', 'GA' ) 
              OR cs_sales_price > 500 ) 
       AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
       AND d_qoy = 1 
       AND d_year = 1998 
GROUP  BY ca_zip 
ORDER  BY ca_zip
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_qoy = 1
    AND d_year = 1998
),
filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk,
         cs_sales_price
  FROM catalog_sales
  WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
),
filtered_addresses AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk,
         ca_zip
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE substr(ca_zip, 1, 5) IN ('85669','86197','88274','83405','86475','85392','85460','80348','81792')
     OR ca_state IN ('CA','WA','GA')
)
SELECT ca.ca_zip,
       SUM(fs.cs_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price
FROM filtered_sales fs
JOIN customer c
  ON fs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
LEFT JOIN filtered_addresses fa
  ON fa.ca_address_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
WHERE fa.ca_address_sk IS NOT NULL
   OR fs.cs_sales_price > 500
GROUP BY ca.ca_zip
ORDER BY ca.ca_zip
LIMIT 100;
