WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date >= DATE '2002-08-22'
      AND d_date < DATE '2002-08-22' + INTERVAL '15 day'
),
ssr AS (
    SELECT s.s_store_id,
           SUM(x.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(x.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(x.return_amt) AS returns1,
           SUM(x.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
               ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
               ss.ss_net_profit AS profit,
               0::numeric(7,2) AS return_amt,
               0::numeric(7,2) AS net_loss
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN filtered_dates fd
          ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
               0::numeric(7,2) AS sales_price,
               0::numeric(7,2) AS profit,
               sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amt,
               sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN filtered_dates fd
          ON fd.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    ) x
    JOIN store s
      ON s.s_store_sk = x.store_sk
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id
),
csr AS (
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(x.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(x.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(x.return_amt) AS returns1,
           SUM(x.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT cs.cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
               cs.cs_net_profit AS profit,
               0::numeric(7,2) AS return_amt,
               0::numeric(7,2) AS net_loss
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN filtered_dates fd
          ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cr.cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               0::numeric(7,2) AS sales_price,
               0::numeric(7,2) AS profit,
               cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amt,
               cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        JOIN filtered_dates fd
          ON fd.d_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk
    ) x
    JOIN catalog_page cp
      ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = x.page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
ws_sales AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON fd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
ws_returns AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS web_site_sk,
           SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS returns1,
           SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_returns wr
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON fd.d_date_sk = wr.wr_returned_date_sk
    JOIN web_sales ws
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
     AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    GROUP BY ws.ws_web_site_sk
),
wsr AS (
    SELECT w.web_site_id,
           COALESCE(s.sales, 0::numeric) AS sales,
           COALESCE(s.profit, 0::numeric) AS profit,
           COALESCE(r.returns1, 0::numeric) AS returns1,
           COALESCE(r.profit_loss, 0::numeric) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_site w
    JOIN (
        SELECT web_site_sk FROM ws_sales
        UNION
        SELECT web_site_sk FROM ws_returns
    ) k
      ON k.web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN ws_sales s
      ON s.web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN ws_returns r
      ON r.web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns1) AS returns1,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || s_store_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns1,
           profit - profit_loss AS profit
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns1,
           profit - profit_loss AS profit
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns1,
           profit - profit_loss AS profit
    FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP(channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT s_store_name, 
               s_company_id, 
               s_street_number, 
               s_street_name, 
               s_street_type, 
               s_suite_number, 
               s_city, 
               s_county, 
               s_state, 
               s_zip, 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30 ) THEN 1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) AS "30 days", 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30 ) 
                          AND ( sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60 ) 
                   THEN 1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) AS "31-60 days", 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60 ) 
                          AND ( sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90 ) 
                   THEN 1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) AS "61-90 days", 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90 ) 
                          AND ( sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120 ) 
                   THEN 1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) AS "91-120 days", 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120 ) THEN 1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) AS ">120 days" 
FROM   store_sales, 
       store_returns, 
       store, 
       date_dim d1, 
       date_dim d2 
WHERE  d2.d_year = 2002 
       AND d2.d_moy = 9 
       AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number 
       AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk 
       AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk 
       AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 
       AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk 
       AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk 
GROUP  BY s_store_name, 
          s_company_id, 
          s_street_number, 
          s_street_name, 
          s_street_type, 
          s_suite_number, 
          s_city, 
          s_county, 
          s_state, 
          s_zip 
ORDER  BY s_store_name, 
          s_company_id, 
          s_street_number, 
          s_street_name, 
          s_street_type, 
          s_suite_number, 
          s_city, 
          s_county, 
          s_state, 
          s_zip
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_returns AS (
    SELECT sr.sr_ticket_number,
           sr.sr_item_sk,
           sr.sr_customer_sk,
           sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    FROM store_returns sr
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year = 2002
      AND d2.d_moy = 9
)
SELECT s.s_store_name,
       s.s_company_id,
       s.s_street_number,
       s.s_street_name,
       s.s_street_type,
       s.s_suite_number,
       s.s_city,
       s.s_county,
       s.s_state,
       s.s_zip,
       SUM(CASE WHEN fr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN fr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 30
                 AND fr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN fr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 60
                 AND fr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN fr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 90
                 AND fr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN fr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM filtered_returns fr
JOIN store_sales ss
  ON ss.ss_ticket_number = fr.sr_ticket_number
 AND ss.ss_item_sk = fr.sr_item_sk
 AND ss.ss_customer_sk = fr.sr_customer_sk
JOIN store s
  ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d1
  ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
GROUP BY s.s_store_name,
         s.s_company_id,
         s.s_street_number,
         s.s_street_name,
         s.s_street_type,
         s.s_suite_number,
         s.s_city,
         s.s_county,
         s.s_state,
         s.s_zip
ORDER BY s.s_store_name,
         s.s_company_id,
         s.s_street_number,
         s.s_street_name,
         s.s_street_type,
         s.s_suite_number,
         s.s_city,
         s.s_county,
         s.s_state,
         s.s_zip
LIMIT 100;

                  d_date, 
                  sum(Sum(ws_sales_price)) OVER (partition BY ws_item_sk ORDER BY d_date rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND      CURRENT row) cume_sales
         FROM     web_sales , 
                  date_dim 
         WHERE    ws_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk 
         AND      d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND      1192+11 
         AND      ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL 
         GROUP BY ws_item_sk, 
                  d_date), store_v1 AS 
( 
         SELECT   ss_item_sk item_sk,

                  sum(sum(ss_sales_price)) OVER (partition BY ss_item_sk ORDER BY d_date rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND      CURRENT row) cume_sales
         FROM     store_sales , 
                  date_dim 
         WHERE    ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk 
         AND      d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND      1192+11 
         AND      ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL 
         GROUP BY ss_item_sk, 
                  d_date) 
SELECT 
         * 
FROM     ( 
                  SELECT   item_sk , 
                           d_date , 
                           web_sales , 
                           store_sales , 
                           max(web_sales) OVER (partition BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND      CURRENT row)   web_cumulative ,
                           max(store_sales) OVER (partition BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND      CURRENT row) store_cumulative
                  FROM     ( 
                                           SELECT

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1192 AND 1203
),
web_daily AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           fd.d_date,
           SUM(ws.ws_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM filtered_dates fd
    JOIN web_sales ws
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, fd.d_date
),
store_daily AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           fd.d_date,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS daily_sales
    FROM filtered_dates fd
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, fd.d_date
),
web_v1 AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS web_cumulative
    FROM web_daily
),
store_v1 AS (
    SELECT item_sk,
           d_date,
           SUM(daily_sales) OVER (
               PARTITION BY item_sk
               ORDER BY d_date
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM store_daily
)
SELECT w.item_sk,
       w.d_date,
       w.web_cumulative AS web_sales,
       s.store_cumulative AS store_sales,
       w.web_cumulative,
       s.store_cumulative
FROM web_v1 w
JOIN store_v1 s
  ON s.item_sk = w.item_sk
 AND s.d_date = w.d_date
WHERE w.web_cumulative > s.store_cumulative
ORDER BY w.item_sk, w.d_date
LIMIT 100;

SELECT dt.d_year, 
               item.i_brand_id         brand_id, 
               item.i_brand            brand, 
               Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) ext_price 
FROM   date_dim dt, 
       store_sales, 
       item 
WHERE  dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk 
       AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
       AND item.i_manager_id = 1 
       AND dt.d_moy = 11 
       AND dt.d_year = 1999 
GROUP  BY dt.d_year, 
          item.i_brand, 
          item.i_brand_id 
ORDER  BY dt.d_year, 
          ext_price DESC, 
          brand_id
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
      AND d_year = 1999
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manager_id = 1
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_ext_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (
        SELECT d_date_sk
        FROM filtered_dates
    )
)
SELECT d.d_year,
       i.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
       i.i_brand AS brand,
       SUM(s.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price
FROM filtered_sales s
JOIN filtered_items i
  ON s.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN filtered_dates d
  ON 1 = 1
GROUP BY d.d_year, i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id
ORDER BY d.d_year, ext_price DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT * 
FROM   (SELECT i_manufact_id, 
               Sum(ss_sales_price)             sum_sales, 
               Avg(Sum(ss_sales_price)) 
                 OVER ( 
                   partition BY i_manufact_id) avg_quarterly_sales 
        FROM   item, 
               store_sales, 
               date_dim, 
               store 
        WHERE  ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
               AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
               AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk 
               AND d_month_seq IN ( 1199, 1199 + 1, 1199 + 2, 1199 + 3, 
                                    1199 + 4, 1199 + 5, 1199 + 6, 1199 + 7, 
                                    1199 + 8, 1199 + 9, 1199 + 10, 1199 + 11 ) 
               AND ( ( i_category IN ( 'Books', 'Children', 'Electronics' ) 
                       AND i_class IN ( 'personal', 'portable', 'reference', 
                                        'self-help' ) 
                       AND i_brand IN ( 'scholaramalgamalg #14', 
                                        'scholaramalgamalg #7' 
                                        , 
                                        'exportiunivamalg #9', 
                                                       'scholaramalgamalg #9' ) 
                     ) 
                      OR ( i_category IN ( 'Women', 'Music', 'Men' ) 
                           AND i_class IN ( 'accessories', 'classical', 
                                            'fragrances', 
                                            'pants' ) 
                           AND i_brand IN ( 'amalgimporto #1', 
                                            'edu packscholar #1', 
                                            'exportiimporto #1', 
                                                'importoamalg #1' ) ) ) 
        GROUP  BY i_manufact_id, 
                  d_qoy) tmp1 
WHERE  CASE 
         WHEN avg_quarterly_sales > 0 THEN Abs (sum_sales - avg_quarterly_sales) 
                                           / 
                                           avg_quarterly_sales 
         ELSE NULL 
       END > 0.1 
ORDER  BY avg_quarterly_sales, 
          sum_sales, 
          i_manufact_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manufact_id
    FROM item
    WHERE (
            i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics')
            AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help')
            AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9')
          )
       OR (
            i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men')
            AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants')
            AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')
          )
), filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_qoy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1199 AND 1210
), quarterly_sales AS (
    SELECT fi.i_manufact_id,
           fd.d_qoy,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
    FROM filtered_items fi
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store s
        WHERE s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    )
    GROUP BY fi.i_manufact_id, fd.d_qoy
), sales_with_avg AS (
    SELECT i_manufact_id,
           sum_sales,
           AVG(sum_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manufact_id) AS avg_quarterly_sales
    FROM quarterly_sales
)
SELECT i_manufact_id,
       sum_sales,
       avg_quarterly_sales
FROM sales_with_avg
WHERE avg_quarterly_sales > 0
  AND ABS(sum_sales - avg_quarterly_sales) / avg_quarterly_sales > 0.1
ORDER BY avg_quarterly_sales, sum_sales, i_manufact_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH my_customers 
     AS (SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, 
                         c_current_addr_sk 
         FROM   (SELECT cs_sold_date_sk     sold_date_sk, 
                        cs_bill_customer_sk customer_sk, 
                        cs_item_sk          item_sk 
                 FROM   catalog_sales 
                 UNION ALL 
                 SELECT ws_sold_date_sk     sold_date_sk, 
                        ws_bill_customer_sk customer_sk, 
                        ws_item_sk          item_sk 
                 FROM   web_sales) cs_or_ws_sales, 
                item, 
                date_dim, 
                customer 
         WHERE  sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND i_category = 'Sports' 
                AND i_class = 'fitness' 
                AND c_customer_sk = cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk 
                AND d_moy = 5 
                AND d_year = 2000), 
     my_revenue 
     AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, 
                Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue 
         FROM   my_customers, 
                store_sales, 
                customer_address, 
                store, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                AND ca_county = s_county 
                AND ca_state = s_state 
                AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk 
                AND d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq + 1 
                                         FROM   date_dim 
                                         WHERE  d_year = 2000 
                                                AND d_moy = 5) AND 
                                        (SELECT DISTINCT 
                                        d_month_seq + 3 
                                         FROM   date_dim 
                                         WHERE  d_year = 2000 
                                                AND d_moy = 5) 
         GROUP  BY c_customer_sk), 
     segments 
     AS (SELECT Cast(( revenue / 50 ) AS INT) AS segment 
         FROM   my_revenue) 
SELECT segment, 
               Count(*)     AS num_customers, 
               segment * 50 AS segment_base 
FROM   segments 
GROUP  BY segment 
ORDER  BY segment, 
          num_customers
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
      AND d_moy = 5
),
month_bounds AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_month_seq) + 1 AS start_month_seq,
           MIN(d_month_seq) + 3 AS end_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
      AND d_moy = 5
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Sports'
      AND i_class = 'fitness'
),
my_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk,
           c.c_current_addr_sk
    FROM customer c
    JOIN (
        SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN filtered_dates fd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
        JOIN filtered_items fi ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
        UNION
        SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN filtered_dates fd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
        JOIN filtered_items fi ON ws.ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    ) s ON c.c_customer_sk = s.customer_sk
),
store_matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.ca_address_sk,
           st.s_store_sk
    FROM customer_address ca
    JOIN store st
      ON ca.ca_county = st.s_county
     AND ca.ca_state = st.s_state
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk,
           ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
           ss.ss_store_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN month_bounds mb
      ON d.d_month_seq BETWEEN mb.start_month_seq AND mb.end_month_seq
),
my_revenue AS (
    SELECT mc.c_customer_sk,
           SUM(fss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM my_customers mc
    JOIN store_matches sm
      ON mc.c_current_addr_sk = sm.ca_address_sk
    JOIN filtered_store_sales fss
      ON fss.ss_customer_sk = mc.c_customer_sk
     AND fss.ss_store_sk = sm.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY mc.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT CAST(revenue / 50 AS INT) AS segment,
       COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
       CAST(revenue / 50 AS INT) * 50 AS segment_base
FROM my_revenue
GROUP BY CAST(revenue / 50 AS INT)
ORDER BY segment, num_customers
LIMIT 100;

SELECT i_brand_id              brand_id, 
               i_brand                 brand, 
               Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) ext_price 
FROM   date_dim, 
       store_sales, 
       item 
WHERE  d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk 
       AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
       AND i_manager_id = 33 
       AND d_moy = 12 
       AND d_year = 1998 
GROUP  BY i_brand, 
          i_brand_id 
ORDER  BY ext_price DESC, 
          i_brand_id
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 12
      AND d_year = 1998
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manager_id = 33
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_ext_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
      AND ss_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM filtered_items)
)
SELECT i.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
       i.i_brand AS brand,
       SUM(s.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price
FROM filtered_sales s
JOIN filtered_items i
  ON s.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id
ORDER BY ext_price DESC, i.i_brand_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH ss 
     AS (SELECT i_item_id, 
                Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) total_sales 
         FROM   store_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                customer_address, 
                item 
         WHERE  i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id 
                              FROM   item 
                              WHERE  i_color IN ( 'firebrick', 'rosy', 'white' ) 
                             ) 
                AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 1998 
                AND d_moy = 3 
                AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                AND ca_gmt_offset = -6 
         GROUP  BY i_item_id), 
     cs 
     AS (SELECT i_item_id, 
                Sum(cs_ext_sales_price) total_sales 
         FROM   catalog_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                customer_address, 
                item 
         WHERE  i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id 
                              FROM   item 
                              WHERE  i_color IN ( 'firebrick', 'rosy', 'white' ) 
                             ) 
                AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 1998 
                AND d_moy = 3 
                AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                AND ca_gmt_offset = -6 
         GROUP  BY i_item_id), 
     ws 
     AS (SELECT i_item_id, 
                Sum(ws_ext_sales_price) total_sales 
         FROM   web_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                customer_address, 
                item 
         WHERE  i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id 
                              FROM   item 
                              WHERE  i_color IN ( 'firebrick', 'rosy', 'white' ) 
                             ) 
                AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 1998 
                AND d_moy = 3 
                AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                AND ca_gmt_offset = -6 
         GROUP  BY i_item_id) 
SELECT i_item_id, 
               Sum(total_sales) total_sales 
FROM   (SELECT * 
        FROM   ss 
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT * 
        FROM   cs 
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT * 
        FROM   ws) tmp1 
GROUP  BY i_item_id 
ORDER  BY total_sales
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
      AND d_moy = 3
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_color IN ('firebrick', 'rosy', 'white')
),
filtered_addresses AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_gmt_offset = -6
)
SELECT x.i_item_id,
       SUM(x.total_sales) AS total_sales
FROM (
    SELECT fi.i_item_id,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_addresses fa
      ON ss.ss_addr_sk = fa.ca_address_sk
    JOIN filtered_items fi
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY fi.i_item_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT fi.i_item_id,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_addresses fa
      ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = fa.ca_address_sk
    JOIN filtered_items fi
      ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY fi.i_item_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT fi.i_item_id,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_addresses fa
      ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = fa.ca_address_sk
    JOIN filtered_items fi
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY fi.i_item_id
) x
GROUP BY x.i_item_id
ORDER BY total_sales
LIMIT 100;

WITH v1 
     AS (SELECT i_category, 
                i_brand, 
                cc_name, 
                d_year, 
                d_moy, 
                Sum(cs_sales_price)                                    sum_sales 
                , 
                Avg(Sum(cs_sales_price)) 
                  OVER ( 
                    partition BY i_category, i_brand, cc_name, d_year) 
                avg_monthly_sales 
                   , 
                Rank() 
                  OVER ( 
                    partition BY i_category, i_brand, cc_name 
                    ORDER BY d_year, d_moy)                            rn 
         FROM   item, 
                catalog_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                call_center 
         WHERE  cs_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND cc_call_center_sk = cs_call_center_sk 
                AND ( d_year = 2000 
                       OR ( d_year = 2000 - 1 
                            AND d_moy = 12 ) 
                       OR ( d_year = 2000 + 1 
                            AND d_moy = 1 ) ) 
         GROUP  BY i_category, 
                   i_brand, 
                   cc_name, 
                   d_year, 
                   d_moy), 
     v2 
     AS (SELECT v1.i_brand, 
                v1.d_year, 
                v1.avg_monthly_sales, 
                v1.sum_sales, 
                v1_lag.sum_sales  psum, 
                v1_lead.sum_sales nsum 
         FROM   v1, 
                v1 v1_lag, 
                v1 v1_lead 
         WHERE  v1.i_category = v1_lag.i_category 
                AND v1.i_category = v1_lead.i_category 
                AND v1.i_brand = v1_lag.i_brand 
                AND v1.i_brand = v1_lead.i_brand 
                AND v1. cc_name = v1_lag. cc_name 
                AND v1. cc_name = v1_lead. cc_name 
                AND v1.rn = v1_lag.rn + 1 
                AND v1.rn = v1_lead.rn - 1) 
SELECT *

WHERE  d_year = 2000 
       AND avg_monthly_sales > 0 
       AND CASE 
             WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN Abs(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) 
                                             / 
                                             avg_monthly_sales 
             ELSE NULL 
           END > 0.1 
ORDER  BY sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales,

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
       OR (d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12)
       OR (d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 1)
), monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        cc.cc_name,
        fd.d_year,
        fd.d_moy,
        SUM(cs.cs_sales_price) AS sum_sales
    FROM filtered_dates fd
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
      ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN call_center cc
      ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
    GROUP BY
        i.i_category,
        i.i_brand,
        cc.cc_name,
        fd.d_year,
        fd.d_moy
), sales_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        ms.i_category,
        ms.i_brand,
        ms.cc_name,
        ms.d_year,
        ms.d_moy,
        ms.sum_sales,
        AVG(ms.sum_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ms.i_category, ms.i_brand, ms.cc_name, ms.d_year
        ) AS avg_monthly_sales,
        LAG(ms.sum_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ms.i_category, ms.i_brand, ms.cc_name
            ORDER BY ms.d_year, ms.d_moy
        ) AS psum,
        LEAD(ms.sum_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ms.i_category, ms.i_brand, ms.cc_name
            ORDER BY ms.d_year, ms.d_moy
        ) AS nsum
    FROM monthly_sales ms
)
SELECT
    i_brand,
    d_year,
    avg_monthly_sales,
    sum_sales,
    psum,
    nsum
FROM sales_enriched
WHERE d_year = 2000
  AND avg_monthly_sales > 0
  AND ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales > 0.1
  AND psum IS NOT NULL
  AND nsum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales, avg_monthly_sales
LIMIT 100;

WITH ss_items 
     AS (SELECT i_item_id               item_id, 
                Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) ss_item_rev 
         FROM   store_sales, 
                item, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date 
                               FROM   date_dim 
                               WHERE  d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq 
                                                    FROM   date_dim 
                                                    WHERE  d_date = '2002-02-25' 
                                                   )) 
                AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
         GROUP  BY i_item_id), 
     cs_items 
     AS (SELECT i_item_id               item_id, 
                Sum(cs_ext_sales_price) cs_item_rev 
         FROM   catalog_sales, 
                item, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  cs_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date 
                               FROM   date_dim 
                               WHERE  d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq 
                                                    FROM   date_dim 
                                                    WHERE  d_date = '2002-02-25' 
                                                   )) 
                AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
         GROUP  BY i_item_id), 
     ws_items 
     AS (SELECT i_item_id               item_id, 
                Sum(ws_ext_sales_price) ws_item_rev 
         FROM   web_sales, 
                item, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  ws_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date 
                               FROM   date_dim 
                               WHERE  d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq 
                                                    FROM   date_dim 
                                                    WHERE  d_date = '2002-02-25' 
                                                   )) 
                AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
         GROUP  BY i_item_id) 
SELECT ss_items.item_id, 
               ss_item_rev, 
               ss_item_rev / ( ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev ) / 3 * 
               100 ss_dev, 
               cs_item_rev, 
               cs_item_rev / ( ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev ) / 3 * 
               100 cs_dev, 
               ws_item_rev, 
               ws_item_rev / ( ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev ) / 3 * 
               100 ws_dev, 
               ( ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev ) / 3 
               average 
FROM   ss_items, 
       cs_items, 
       ws_items 
WHERE  ss_items.item_id = cs_items.item_id 
       AND ss_items.item_id = ws_items.item_id 
       AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev 
       AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev 
       AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev 
       AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev 
       AND ws_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev 
       AND ws_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev 
ORDER  BY item_id, 
          ss_item_rev
LIMIT 100;

WITH target_week AS (
    SELECT d2.d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim d1
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_week_seq = d1.d_week_seq
    WHERE d1.d_date = DATE '2002-02-25'
),
ss_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
    FROM target_week tw
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = tw.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
cs_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
    FROM target_week tw
    JOIN catalog_sales cs
      ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = tw.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
),
ws_items AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id,
           SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
    FROM target_week tw
    JOIN web_sales ws
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = tw.d_date_sk
    JOIN item i
      ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
)
SELECT ss.item_id,
       ss.ss_item_rev,
       ss.ss_item_rev / NULLIF(ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev, 0) / 3 * 100 AS ss_dev,
       cs.cs_item_rev,
       cs.cs_item_rev / NULLIF(ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev, 0) / 3 * 100 AS cs_dev,
       ws.ws_item_rev,
       ws.ws_item_rev / NULLIF(ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev, 0) / 3 * 100 AS ws_dev,
       (ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev) / 3 AS average
FROM ws_items ws
JOIN cs_items cs
  ON cs.item_id = ws.item_id
JOIN ss_items ss
  ON ss.item_id = ws.item_id
 AND ss.ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs.cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs.cs_item_rev
 AND ss.ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws.ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws.ws_item_rev
 AND cs.cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws.ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws.ws_item_rev
ORDER BY ss.item_id, ss.ss_item_rev
LIMIT 100;

                      ELSE NULL

                    END) wed_sales, 
                Sum(CASE 
                      WHEN ( d_day_name = 'Thursday' ) THEN ss_sales_price 
                      ELSE NULL 
                    END) thu_sales, 
                Sum(CASE 
                      WHEN ( d_day_name = 'Friday' ) THEN ss_sales_price 
                      ELSE NULL 
                    END) fri_sales, 
                Sum(CASE 
                      WHEN ( d_day_name = 'Saturday' ) THEN ss_sales_price 
                      ELSE NULL 
                    END) sat_sales 
         FROM   store_sales, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk 
         GROUP  BY d_week_seq, 
                   ss_store_sk) 
SELECT s_store_name1, 
               s_store_id1, 
               d_week_seq1, 
               sun_sales1 / sun_sales2, 
               mon_sales1 / mon_sales2, 
               tue_sales1 / tue_sales2, 
               wed_sales1 / wed_sales2, 
               thu_sales1 / thu_sales2, 
               fri_sales1 / fri_sales2, 
               sat_sales1 / sat_sales2 
FROM   (SELECT s_store_name   s_store_name1, 
               wss.d_week_seq d_week_seq1, 
               s_store_id     s_store_id1, 
               sun_sales      sun_sales1,

               tue_sales      tue_sales1,

               fri_sales      fri_sales1, 
               sat_sales      sat_sales1 
        FROM   wss, 
               store,

        WHERE  d.d_week_seq = wss.d_week_seq

WITH month_weeks_1 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d_week_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1196 AND 1207
),
month_weeks_2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d_week_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1208 AND 1219
),
wss AS (
    SELECT
        dd.d_week_seq,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE dd.d_day_name = 'Sunday') AS sun_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE dd.d_day_name = 'Monday') AS mon_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE dd.d_day_name = 'Tuesday') AS tue_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE dd.d_day_name = 'Wednesday') AS wed_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE dd.d_day_name = 'Thursday') AS thu_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE dd.d_day_name = 'Friday') AS fri_sales,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE dd.d_day_name = 'Saturday') AS sat_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim dd
      ON dd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1196 AND 1219
    GROUP BY dd.d_week_seq, ss.ss_store_sk
),
y AS (
    SELECT
        w.d_week_seq,
        w.ss_store_sk,
        w.sun_sales,
        w.mon_sales,
        w.tue_sales,
        w.wed_sales,
        w.thu_sales,
        w.fri_sales,
        w.sat_sales
    FROM wss w
    JOIN month_weeks_1 mw
      ON mw.d_week_seq = w.d_week_seq
),
x AS (
    SELECT
        w.d_week_seq,
        w.ss_store_sk,
        w.sun_sales,
        w.mon_sales,
        w.tue_sales,
        w.wed_sales,
        w.thu_sales,
        w.fri_sales,
        w.sat_sales
    FROM wss w
    JOIN month_weeks_2 mw
      ON mw.d_week_seq = w.d_week_seq
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_store_id,
    y.d_week_seq,
    y.sun_sales / NULLIF(x.sun_sales, 0),
    y.mon_sales / NULLIF(x.mon_sales, 0),
    y.tue_sales / NULLIF(x.tue_sales, 0),
    y.wed_sales / NULLIF(x.wed_sales, 0),
    y.thu_sales / NULLIF(x.thu_sales, 0),
    y.fri_sales / NULLIF(x.fri_sales, 0),
    y.sat_sales / NULLIF(x.sat_sales, 0)
FROM y
JOIN x
  ON x.ss_store_sk = y.ss_store_sk
 AND x.d_week_seq = y.d_week_seq + 52
JOIN store s
  ON s.s_store_sk = y.ss_store_sk
ORDER BY s.s_store_name, s.s_store_id, y.d_week_seq
LIMIT 100;

SELECT a.ca_state state, 
               Count(*)   cnt 
FROM   customer_address a, 
       customer c, 
       store_sales s, 
       date_dim d, 
       item i 
WHERE  a.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk 
       AND c.c_customer_sk = s.ss_customer_sk 
       AND s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
       AND s.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk 
       AND d.d_month_seq = (SELECT DISTINCT ( d_month_seq ) 
                            FROM   date_dim 
                            WHERE  d_year = 1998 
                                   AND d_moy = 7) 
       AND i.i_current_price > 1.2 * (SELECT Avg(j.i_current_price) 
                                      FROM   item j 
                                      WHERE  j.i_category = i.i_category) 
GROUP  BY a.ca_state 
HAVING Count(*) >= 10 
ORDER  BY cnt
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH month_filter AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998
    AND d_moy = 7
), category_avg AS (
  SELECT i_category, AVG(i_current_price) AS avg_price
  FROM item
  GROUP BY i_category
), filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT s.ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales s
  JOIN month_filter d ON d.d_date_sk = s.ss_sold_date_sk
  JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk
  JOIN category_avg ca ON ca.i_category = i.i_category
  WHERE i.i_current_price > 1.2 * ca.avg_price
)
SELECT a.ca_state AS state,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM filtered_sales fs
JOIN customer c ON c.c_customer_sk = fs.ss_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address a ON a.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
GROUP BY a.ca_state
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY cnt
LIMIT 100;

WITH ss

                Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) total_sales 
         FROM   store_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                customer_address, 
                item 
         WHERE  i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id 
                              FROM   item 
                              WHERE  i_category IN ( 'Jewelry' )) 
                AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 1999 
                AND d_moy = 8 
                AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                AND ca_gmt_offset = -6 
         GROUP  BY i_item_id), 
     cs 
     AS (SELECT i_item_id, 
                Sum(cs_ext_sales_price) total_sales 
         FROM   catalog_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                customer_address, 
                item 
         WHERE  i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id 
                              FROM   item 
                              WHERE  i_category IN ( 'Jewelry' )) 
                AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 1999 
                AND d_moy = 8 
                AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                AND ca_gmt_offset = -6 
         GROUP  BY i_item_id), 
     ws 
     AS (SELECT i_item_id, 
                Sum(ws_ext_sales_price) total_sales 
         FROM   web_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                customer_address, 
                item 
         WHERE  i_item_id IN (SELECT i_item_id 
                              FROM   item 
                              WHERE  i_category IN ( 'Jewelry' )) 
                AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 1999 
                AND d_moy = 8 
                AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                AND ca_gmt_offset = -6 
         GROUP  BY i_item_id) 
SELECT i_item_id, 
               Sum(total_sales) total_sales 
FROM   (SELECT * 
        FROM   ss 
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT * 
        FROM   cs 
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT * 
        FROM   ws) tmp1 
GROUP  BY i_item_id

          total_sales

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
      AND d_moy = 8
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Jewelry'
),
filtered_addresses AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_gmt_offset = -6
),
all_sales AS (
    SELECT fi.i_item_id, ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS ext_sales_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_addresses fa
      ON ss.ss_addr_sk = fa.ca_address_sk
    JOIN filtered_items fi
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk

    UNION ALL

    SELECT fi.i_item_id, cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS ext_sales_price
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_addresses fa
      ON cs.cs_bill_addr_sk = fa.ca_address_sk
    JOIN filtered_items fi
      ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk

    UNION ALL

    SELECT fi.i_item_id, ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS ext_sales_price
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_addresses fa
      ON ws.ws_bill_addr_sk = fa.ca_address_sk
    JOIN filtered_items fi
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
)
SELECT i_item_id,
       SUM(ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
FROM all_sales
GROUP BY i_item_id
ORDER BY i_item_id, total_sales
LIMIT 100;

FROM   (SELECT Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) promotions

               AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
               AND ca_gmt_offset = -7 
               AND i_category = 'Books' 
               AND ( p_channel_dmail = 'Y' 
                      OR p_channel_email = 'Y' 
                      OR p_channel_tv = 'Y' ) 
               AND s_gmt_offset = -7 
               AND d_year = 2001 
               AND d_moy = 12) promotional_sales,

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
      AND d_moy = 12
), filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Books'
), filtered_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_gmt_offset = -7
), filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    WHERE ca.ca_gmt_offset = -7
), filtered_promotions AS (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_dmail = 'Y'
       OR p_channel_email = 'Y'
       OR p_channel_tv = 'Y'
), base_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_ext_sales_price,
           ss.ss_promo_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates d
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_items i
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_stores s
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN filtered_customers c
      ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
)
SELECT promotions,
       total,
       CAST(promotions AS DECIMAL(15,4)) / NULLIF(CAST(total AS DECIMAL(15,4)), 0) * 100 AS pct
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN fp.p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN bs.ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS promotions,
           SUM(bs.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total
    FROM base_sales bs
    LEFT JOIN filtered_promotions fp
      ON bs.ss_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk
) x
ORDER BY promotions, total
LIMIT 100;

SELECT Substr(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20), 
               sm_type, 
               web_name, 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk <= 30 ) THEN 1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) AS "30 days", 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk > 30 ) 
                          AND ( ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk <= 60 ) THEN 1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) AS "31-60 days", 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk > 60 ) 
                          AND ( ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk <= 90 ) THEN 1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) AS "61-90 days", 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk > 90 ) 
                          AND ( ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk <= 120 ) THEN 
                     1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) AS "91-120 days", 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk > 120 ) THEN 1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) AS ">120 days" 
FROM   web_sales, 
       warehouse, 
       ship_mode, 
       web_site, 
       date_dim 
WHERE  d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1222 + 11 
       AND ws_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk 
       AND ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk 
       AND ws_ship_mode_sk = sm_ship_mode_sk 
       AND ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk 
GROUP  BY Substr(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20), 
          sm_type, 
          web_name 
ORDER  BY Substr(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20), 
          sm_type, 
          web_name
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233
), filtered_web_sales AS (
  SELECT ws_warehouse_sk,
         ws_ship_mode_sk,
         ws_web_site_sk,
         (ws_ship_date_sk - ws_sold_date_sk) AS ship_delay
  FROM web_sales
  WHERE ws_ship_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_dates)
)
SELECT substr(w.w_warehouse_name, 1, 20) AS warehouse_name,
       sm.sm_type,
       ws.web_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN fws.ship_delay <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN fws.ship_delay > 30 AND fws.ship_delay <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN fws.ship_delay > 60 AND fws.ship_delay <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN fws.ship_delay > 90 AND fws.ship_delay <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN fws.ship_delay > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM filtered_web_sales fws
JOIN warehouse w
  ON fws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN ship_mode sm
  ON fws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN web_site ws
  ON fws.ws_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk
GROUP BY substr(w.w_warehouse_name, 1, 20),
         sm.sm_type,
         ws.web_name
ORDER BY substr(w.w_warehouse_name, 1, 20),
         sm.sm_type,
         ws.web_name
LIMIT 100;

SELECT * 
FROM   (SELECT i_manager_id, 
               Sum(ss_sales_price)            sum_sales, 
               Avg(Sum(ss_sales_price)) 
                 OVER ( 
                   partition BY i_manager_id) avg_monthly_sales 
        FROM   item, 
               store_sales, 
               date_dim, 
               store 
        WHERE  ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
               AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
               AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk 
               AND d_month_seq IN ( 1200, 1200 + 1, 1200 + 2, 1200 + 3, 
                                    1200 + 4, 1200 + 5, 1200 + 6, 1200 + 7, 
                                    1200 + 8, 1200 + 9, 1200 + 10, 1200 + 11 ) 
               AND ( ( i_category IN ( 'Books', 'Children', 'Electronics' ) 
                       AND i_class IN ( 'personal', 'portable', 'reference', 
                                        'self-help' ) 
                       AND i_brand IN ( 'scholaramalgamalg #14', 
                                        'scholaramalgamalg #7' 
                                        , 
                                        'exportiunivamalg #9', 
                                                       'scholaramalgamalg #9' ) 
                     ) 
                      OR ( i_category IN ( 'Women', 'Music', 'Men' ) 
                           AND i_class IN ( 'accessories', 'classical', 
                                            'fragrances', 
                                            'pants' ) 
                           AND i_brand IN ( 'amalgimporto #1', 
                                            'edu packscholar #1', 
                                            'exportiimporto #1', 
                                                'importoamalg #1' ) ) ) 
        GROUP  BY i_manager_id, 
                  d_moy) tmp1 
WHERE  CASE 
         WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN Abs (sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / 
                                         avg_monthly_sales 
         ELSE NULL 
       END > 0.1 
ORDER  BY i_manager_id, 
          avg_monthly_sales, 
          sum_sales
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE (
            i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics')
            AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help')
            AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9')
          )
       OR (
            i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men')
            AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants')
            AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')
          )
), filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1200 AND 1211
), monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT fi.i_manager_id,
           fd.d_moy,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
    FROM filtered_item fi
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store s
        WHERE s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    )
    GROUP BY fi.i_manager_id, fd.d_moy
), manager_sales AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id,
           sum_sales,
           AVG(sum_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM monthly_sales
)
SELECT i_manager_id,
       sum_sales,
       avg_monthly_sales
FROM manager_sales
WHERE avg_monthly_sales > 0
  AND ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales > 0.1
ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
LIMIT 100;

     AS (SELECT cs_item_sk, 
                Sum(cs_ext_list_price) AS sale, 
                Sum(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge 
                    + cr_store_credit) AS refund 
         FROM   catalog_sales, 
                catalog_returns 
         WHERE  cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk 
                AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number 
         GROUP  BY cs_item_sk 
         HAVING Sum(cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * Sum( 
                cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge 
                + cr_store_credit)), 
     cross_sales 
     AS (SELECT i_product_name         product_name, 
                i_item_sk              item_sk, 
                s_store_name           store_name, 
                s_zip                  store_zip, 
                ad1.ca_street_number   b_street_number,

                ad1.ca_city            b_city, 
                ad1.ca_zip             b_zip, 
                ad2.ca_street_number   c_street_number,

                ad2.ca_city            c_city, 
                ad2.ca_zip             c_zip, 
                d1.d_year              AS syear, 
                d2.d_year              AS fsyear, 
                d3.d_year              s2year, 
                Count(*)               cnt, 
                Sum(ss_wholesale_cost) s1,

         FROM   store_sales, 
                store_returns, 
                cs_ui, 
                date_dim d1, 
                date_dim d2, 
                date_dim d3, 
                store, 
                customer, 
                customer_demographics cd1, 
                customer_demographics cd2, 
                promotion, 
                household_demographics hd1, 
                household_demographics hd2, 
                customer_address ad1, 
                customer_address ad2, 
                income_band ib1, 
                income_band ib2, 
                item 
         WHERE  ss_store_sk = s_store_sk 
                AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk 
                AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
                AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk 
                AND ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk 
                AND ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk 
                AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk 
                AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number 
                AND ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk 
                AND c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk 
                AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk 
                AND c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk

                AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk 
                AND hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk 
                AND hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk 
                AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status 
                AND i_color IN ( 'cyan', 'peach', 'blush', 'frosted', 
                                 'powder', 'orange' ) 
                AND i_current_price BETWEEN 58 AND 58 + 10 
                AND i_current_price BETWEEN 58 + 1 AND 58 + 15 
         GROUP  BY i_product_name, 
                   i_item_sk, 
                   s_store_name, 
                   s_zip, 
                   ad1.ca_street_number, 
                   ad1.ca_street_name, 
                   ad1.ca_city, 
                   ad1.ca_zip, 
                   ad2.ca_street_number, 
                   ad2.ca_street_name, 
                   ad2.ca_city, 
                   ad2.ca_zip, 
                   d1.d_year, 
                   d2.d_year, 
                   d3.d_year) 
SELECT cs1.product_name,

       cs1.b_street_number,

       cs2.s1, 
       cs2.s2, 
       cs2.s3, 
       cs2.syear, 
       cs2.cnt 
FROM   cross_sales cs1, 
       cross_sales cs2 
WHERE  cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk

WITH cs_ui AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
      ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
     AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash + cr.cr_reversed_charge + cr.cr_store_credit)
),
filtered_items AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_sk,
        i.i_product_name
    FROM item i
    WHERE i.i_color IN ('cyan', 'peach', 'blush', 'frosted', 'powder', 'orange')
      AND i.i_current_price BETWEEN 59 AND 68
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM cs_ui u
          WHERE u.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      )
),
base_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        fi.i_product_name AS product_name,
        fi.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        s.s_zip AS store_zip,
        ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
        ad1.ca_street_name AS b_streen_name,
        ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
        ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
        ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
        ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
        ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
        ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
        d1.d_year AS syear,
        d2.d_year AS fsyear,
        d3.d_year AS s2year,
        ss.ss_wholesale_cost,
        ss.ss_list_price,
        ss.ss_coupon_amt
    FROM filtered_items fi
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
      ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
     AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    JOIN store s
      ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1
      ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
     AND d1.d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    JOIN customer c
      ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1
      ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2
      ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
     AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
    JOIN household_demographics hd1
      ON hd1.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2
      ON hd2.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad1
      ON ad1.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad2
      ON ad2.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2
      ON d2.d_date_sk = c.c_first_sales_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d3
      ON d3.d_date_sk = c.c_first_shipto_date_sk
    JOIN promotion p
      ON p.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
    JOIN income_band ib1
      ON ib1.ib_income_band_sk = hd1.hd_income_band_sk
    JOIN income_band ib2
      ON ib2.ib_income_band_sk = hd2.hd_income_band_sk
),
cross_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        product_name,
        item_sk,
        store_name,
        store_zip,
        b_street_number,
        b_streen_name,
        b_city,
        b_zip,
        c_street_number,
        c_street_name,
        c_city,
        c_zip,
        syear,
        fsyear,
        s2year,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        SUM(ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
        SUM(ss_list_price) AS s2,
        SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
    FROM base_sales
    GROUP BY
        product_name,
        item_sk,
        store_name,
        store_zip,
        b_street_number,
        b_streen_name,
        b_city,
        b_zip,
        c_street_number,
        c_street_name,
        c_city,
        c_zip,
        syear,
        fsyear,
        s2year
),
cs_2001 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT *
    FROM cross_sales
    WHERE syear = 2001
),
cs_2002 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT *
    FROM cross_sales
    WHERE syear = 2002
)
SELECT
    cs1.product_name,
    cs1.store_name,
    cs1.store_zip,
    cs1.b_street_number,
    cs1.b_streen_name,
    cs1.b_city,
    cs1.b_zip,
    cs1.c_street_number,
    cs1.c_street_name,
    cs1.c_city,
    cs1.c_zip,
    cs1.syear,
    cs1.cnt,
    cs1.s1,
    cs1.s2,
    cs1.s3,
    cs2.s1,
    cs2.s2,
    cs2.s3,
    cs2.syear,
    cs2.cnt
FROM cs_2001 cs1
JOIN cs_2002 cs2
  ON cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk
 AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name
 AND cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip
 AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt
ORDER BY
    cs1.product_name,
    cs1.store_name,
    cs2.cnt;

SELECT s_store_name, 
               i_item_desc, 
               sc.revenue, 
               i_current_price, 
               i_wholesale_cost, 
               i_brand 
FROM   store, 
       item, 
       (SELECT ss_store_sk, 
               Avg(revenue) AS ave 
        FROM   (SELECT ss_store_sk, 
                       ss_item_sk, 
                       Sum(ss_sales_price) AS revenue 
                FROM   store_sales, 
                       date_dim 
                WHERE  ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                       AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1199 AND 1199 + 11 
                GROUP  BY ss_store_sk, 
                          ss_item_sk) sa 
        GROUP  BY ss_store_sk) sb, 
       (SELECT ss_store_sk, 
               ss_item_sk, 
               Sum(ss_sales_price) AS revenue 
        FROM   store_sales, 
               date_dim 
        WHERE  ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
               AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1199 AND 1199 + 11 
        GROUP  BY ss_store_sk, 
                  ss_item_sk) sc 
WHERE  sb.ss_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk 
       AND sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sb.ave 
       AND s_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk 
       AND i_item_sk = sc.ss_item_sk 
ORDER  BY s_store_name, 
          i_item_desc
LIMIT 100;
q2: WITH filtered_dates AS (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1199 AND 1210), store_item_revenue AS (SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS revenue FROM store_sales ss JOIN filtered_dates fd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk), store_avg AS (SELECT ss_store_sk, AVG(revenue) AS ave FROM store_item_revenue GROUP BY ss_store_sk) SELECT s.s_store_name, i.i_item_desc, sir.revenue, i.i_current_price, i.i_wholesale_cost, i.i_brand FROM store_avg sa JOIN store_item_revenue sir ON sa.ss_store_sk = sir.ss_store_sk AND sir.revenue <= 0.1 * sa.ave JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = sir.ss_store_sk JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = sir.ss_item_sk ORDER BY s.s_store_name, i.i_item_desc LIMIT 100;

SELECT cd_gender, 
               cd_marital_status, 
               cd_education_status, 
               Count(*) cnt1, 
               cd_purchase_estimate, 
               Count(*) cnt2, 
               cd_credit_rating, 
               Count(*) cnt3 
FROM   customer c, 
       customer_address ca, 
       customer_demographics 
WHERE  c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
       AND ca_state IN ( 'KS', 'AZ', 'NE' ) 
       AND cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk 
       AND EXISTS (SELECT * 
                   FROM   store_sales, 
                          date_dim 
                   WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk 
                          AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                          AND d_year = 2004 
                          AND d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 3 + 2) 
       AND ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT * 
                         FROM   web_sales, 
                                date_dim 
                         WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk 
                                AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                                AND d_year = 2004 
                                AND d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 3 + 2) 
             AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * 
                             FROM   catalog_sales, 
                                    date_dim 
                             WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk 
                                    AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                                    AND d_year = 2004 
                                    AND d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 3 + 2) ) 
GROUP  BY cd_gender, 
          cd_marital_status, 
          cd_education_status, 
          cd_purchase_estimate, 
          cd_credit_rating 
ORDER  BY cd_gender, 
          cd_marital_status, 
          cd_education_status, 
          cd_purchase_estimate, 
          cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2004
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 3 AND 5
),
filtered_addresses AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('KS', 'AZ', 'NE')
),
store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates fd ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
),
web_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN filtered_dates fd ON fd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
),
catalog_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN filtered_dates fd ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT cd.cd_gender,
       cd.cd_marital_status,
       cd.cd_education_status,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
       cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
       cd.cd_credit_rating,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt3
FROM customer c
JOIN filtered_addresses ca
  ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN store_customers sc
  ON c.c_customer_sk = sc.customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_customers wc
  ON c.c_customer_sk = wc.customer_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_customers cc
  ON c.c_customer_sk = cc.customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
WHERE wc.customer_sk IS NULL
  AND cc.customer_sk IS NULL
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender,
         cd.cd_marital_status,
         cd.cd_education_status,
         cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
         cd.cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd.cd_gender,
         cd.cd_marital_status,
         cd.cd_education_status,
         cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
         cd.cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100;

       AND ( p_channel_email = 'N'

       AND d_year = 1998 
GROUP  BY i_item_id

           ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates d
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_customers cd
      ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN filtered_promotions p
      ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       AVG(fs.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
       AVG(fs.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
       AVG(fs.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       AVG(fs.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM filtered_sales fs
JOIN item i
  ON fs.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT i_brand_id     brand_id, 
       i_brand        brand, 
       t_hour, 
       t_minute, 
       Sum(ext_price) ext_price 
FROM   item, 
       (SELECT ws_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, 
               ws_sold_date_sk    AS sold_date_sk, 
               ws_item_sk         AS sold_item_sk, 
               ws_sold_time_sk    AS time_sk 
        FROM   web_sales, 
               date_dim 
        WHERE  d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk 
               AND d_moy = 11 
               AND d_year = 2001 
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT cs_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, 
               cs_sold_date_sk    AS sold_date_sk, 
               cs_item_sk         AS sold_item_sk, 
               cs_sold_time_sk    AS time_sk 
        FROM   catalog_sales, 
               date_dim 
        WHERE  d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk 
               AND d_moy = 11 
               AND d_year = 2001 
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT ss_ext_sales_price AS ext_price, 
               ss_sold_date_sk    AS sold_date_sk, 
               ss_item_sk         AS sold_item_sk, 
               ss_sold_time_sk    AS time_sk 
        FROM   store_sales, 
               date_dim 
        WHERE  d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk 
               AND d_moy = 11 
               AND d_year = 2001) AS tmp, 
       time_dim 
WHERE  sold_item_sk = i_item_sk 
       AND i_manager_id = 1 
       AND time_sk = t_time_sk 
       AND ( t_meal_time = 'breakfast' 
              OR t_meal_time = 'dinner' ) 
GROUP  BY i_brand, 
          i_brand_id, 
          t_hour, 
          t_minute 
ORDER  BY ext_price DESC, 
          i_brand_id;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
      AND d_year = 2001
),
filtered_times AS (
    SELECT t_time_sk, t_hour, t_minute
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_meal_time IN ('breakfast', 'dinner')
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manager_id = 1
),
sales AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
           ws_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
           ws_ext_sales_price AS ext_price
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON fd.d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
           cs_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
           cs_ext_sales_price AS ext_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON fd.d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           ss_sold_time_sk AS time_sk,
           ss_ext_sales_price AS ext_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_dates fd
      ON fd.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT i.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
       i.i_brand AS brand,
       t.t_hour,
       t.t_minute,
       SUM(s.ext_price) AS ext_price
FROM sales s
JOIN filtered_times t
  ON t.t_time_sk = s.time_sk
JOIN filtered_items i
  ON i.i_item_sk = s.item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_brand, t.t_hour, t.t_minute
ORDER BY ext_price DESC, i.i_brand_id;

q1:
SELECT i_item_desc, 
               w_warehouse_name, 
               d1.d_week_seq, 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN p_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) no_promo, 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 
                     ELSE 0 
                   END) promo, 
               Count(*) total_cnt 
FROM   catalog_sales 
       JOIN inventory 
         ON ( cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk ) 
       JOIN warehouse 
         ON ( w_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk ) 
       JOIN item 
         ON ( i_item_sk = cs_item_sk ) 
       JOIN customer_demographics 
         ON ( cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk ) 
       JOIN household_demographics 
         ON ( cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk ) 
       JOIN date_dim d1 
         ON ( cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk ) 
       JOIN date_dim d2 
         ON ( inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk ) 
       JOIN date_dim d3 
         ON ( cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk ) 
       LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion 
                    ON ( cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk ) 
       LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns 
                    ON ( cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk 
                         AND cr_order_number = cs_order_number ) 
WHERE  d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq 
       AND inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity 
       AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '5 day' 
       AND hd_buy_potential = '501-1000' 
       AND d1.d_year = 2002 
       AND cd_marital_status = 'M' 
GROUP  BY i_item_desc, 
          w_warehouse_name, 
          d1.d_week_seq 
ORDER  BY total_cnt DESC, 
          i_item_desc, 
          w_warehouse_name, 
          d_week_seq
LIMIT 100;

WITH d1_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_week_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
),
cs_filtered AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk,
           cs_order_number,
           cs_quantity,
           cs_promo_sk,
           cs_sold_date_sk,
           cs_ship_date_sk,
           cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
           cs_bill_hdemo_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM customer_demographics cd
        WHERE cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
          AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'M'
    )
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM household_demographics hd
        WHERE hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
          AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '501-1000'
    )
)
SELECT i.i_item_desc,
       w.w_warehouse_name,
       d1.d_week_seq,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cs_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_promo,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cs_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo,
       COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM cs_filtered cs
JOIN d1_filtered d1
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d3
  ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_ship_date_sk
 AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '5 day'
JOIN inventory inv
  ON inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
 AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < cs.cs_quantity
JOIN date_dim d2
  ON d2.d_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk
 AND d2.d_week_seq = d1.d_week_seq
JOIN warehouse w
  ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
JOIN item i

 AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
GROUP BY i.i_item_desc,
         w.w_warehouse_name,
         d1.d_week_seq
ORDER BY total_cnt DESC,
         i.i_item_desc,
         w.w_warehouse_name,

SELECT c_last_name, 
       c_first_name, 
       c_salutation, 
       c_preferred_cust_flag, 
       ss_ticket_number, 
       cnt 
FROM   (SELECT ss_ticket_number, 
               ss_customer_sk, 
               Count(*) cnt 
        FROM   store_sales, 
               date_dim, 
               store, 
               household_demographics 
        WHERE  store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
               AND store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk 
               AND store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk 
               AND date_dim.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2 
               AND ( household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '>10000' 
                      OR household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '0-500' ) 
               AND household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0 
               AND CASE 
                     WHEN household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0 THEN 
                     household_demographics.hd_dep_count / 
                     household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count 
                     ELSE NULL 
                   END > 1 
               AND date_dim.d_year IN ( 2000, 2000 + 1, 2000 + 2 ) 
               AND store.s_county IN ( 'Williamson County', 'Williamson County', 
                                       'Williamson County', 
                                                             'Williamson County' 
                                     ) 
        GROUP  BY ss_ticket_number, 
                  ss_customer_sk) dj, 
       customer 
WHERE  ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
       AND cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5 
ORDER  BY cnt DESC, 
          c_last_name ASC;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
      AND d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2002
),
filtered_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_county = 'Williamson County'
),
filtered_hd AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND hd_buy_potential IN ('>10000', '0-500')
      AND hd_dep_count > hd_vehicle_count
),
agg AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number,
           ss.ss_customer_sk,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN filtered_dates d
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_stores s
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
    JOIN filtered_hd hd
      ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
)
SELECT c.c_last_name,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_salutation,
       c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       agg.ss_ticket_number,
       agg.cnt
FROM agg
JOIN customer c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = agg.ss_customer_sk
ORDER BY agg.cnt DESC, c.c_last_name ASC;

                c_first_name     customer_first_name, 
                c_last_name      customer_last_name, 
                d_year           AS year1, 
                Sum(ss_net_paid) year_total, 
                's'              sale_type 
         FROM   customer, 
                store_sales, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk 
                AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year IN ( 1999, 1999 + 1 ) 
         GROUP  BY c_customer_id, 
                   c_first_name, 
                   c_last_name, 
                   d_year 
         UNION ALL 
         SELECT c_customer_id    customer_id, 
                c_first_name     customer_first_name, 
                c_last_name      customer_last_name, 
                d_year           AS year1, 
                Sum(ws_net_paid) year_total, 
                'w'              sale_type 
         FROM   customer, 
                web_sales, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk 
                AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year IN ( 1999, 1999 + 1 ) 
         GROUP  BY c_customer_id, 
                   c_first_name, 
                   c_last_name, 
                   d_year) 
SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id,

WITH date_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year IN (1999, 2000)
),
store_year AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_year = 1999 THEN ss.ss_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS s_1999,
           SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_year = 2000 THEN ss.ss_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS s_2000
    FROM date_filtered d
    JOIN store_sales ss
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
      ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_year = 1999 THEN ss.ss_net_paid ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
web_year AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_year = 1999 THEN ws.ws_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS w_1999,
           SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_year = 2000 THEN ws.ws_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS w_2000
    FROM date_filtered d
    JOIN web_sales ws
      ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c
      ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_year = 1999 THEN ws.ws_net_paid ELSE 0 END) > 0
)
SELECT s.customer_id,
       s.customer_first_name,
       s.customer_last_name
FROM store_year s
